title: UI/UX Director
description:
Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

**About the Role:**
===================

As UI/UX Director, you will set the design vision for Labhouse and be accountable for the quality and impact of the experience across our whole app portfolio. Working as a direct partner to the CEO and Head of Product, you will decide how design is done in the company: the standards, the process, the team and the level of craft that sets our apps apart.

This is a leadership role with **deep craft and hands-on work**. You will set the strategy and build the design team, and still step in on the work that matters most, from defining a new app's concept to reviewing the final pixels, animations and store assets. You will own the design system across all products, make sure every launch meets a best-in-class bar, and tie design decisions directly to business results: activation, retention, conversion and store performance.

**What you'll own:**
====================

* **Design vision and strategy:** define the UI/UX principles, visual language and quality bar for the whole portfolio, and bring them to every product decision at leadership level.
* **0 1 launches:** lead the experience for new apps from concept to launch, including research, benchmarking, prototyping and validation with real users.
* **Craft and production quality:** set the standard for every asset we ship: UI, illustrations, icons, motion, animations, store screenshots and videos, and make sure what engineering ships matches what was designed.
* **Measurable design impact:** work with Product and Data to turn onboarding, paywall, core flow and store-asset improvements into measurable gains in activation, conversion, retention and store conversion rate.
* **Design system at scale:** own a portfolio-wide design system that lets us launch new apps faster while keeping consistency and craft.
* **AI-native design workflows:** introduce AI tools into research, ideation, asset creation and prototyping to multiply the team's output.
* **Build and scale design teams**: hiring, mentoring and developing senior talent.

**About You:**
==============

**Craft and technical expertise:**

* Solid track record in product, UX/UI, or visual design, including leading design teams or a design function.
* Experience leading the design of consumer mobile apps from scratch to scale (ideally millions of users), with clear business impact you can quantify.
* A portfolio that shows both exceptional craft and strategic thinking: from early concepts to shipped, high-performing products.
* An artistic eye for color, composition, typography and motion, able to lead and review any type of asset.
* Mastery of Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, and the ability to jump in hands-on.
* Deep knowledge of iOS and Android design guidelines, and of how to go beyond them to create distinctive experiences.

**Product and business focus:**

* Experience owning design strategy at leadership level and influencing founders and executives on product direction.
* A product-first mindset: you think in user problems, hypotheses and outcomes, not just screens.
* Comfortable working with data: you use analytics, A/B tests and store metrics to guide and defend design decisions.
* Strong understanding of consumer app monetization (subscriptions, paywalls, onboarding) and how design moves it.
* Self-driven and entrepreneurial, with high ownership and comfort working directly with founders in a fast-paced environment.

**Communication:**

* Fluent in spoken and written English
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and marketing.

**Nice to Have:**
=================

* Experience in a portfolio or app studio model, managing design across several products at the same time.

**What we Offer:**
==================

* Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week.
* Flexible working hours.
* Permanent contract with competitive compensation.
* High-end equipment for your development.
* A top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment.
* Opportunity to lead, grow, and take on big challenges.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies, including the chance to integrate AI models into new apps.

**Hiring Process**
==================

* **TA Interview** – Initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background.
* **CEO** – Deep dive into your product thinking, design experience, and fit with the team.
* **Technical Case** – Practical exercise to assess your product, analytical, and strategic capabilities.
* **Final Interview** – Final conversation to ensure alignment on expectations, culture, and role fit.

**You should Know:**
====================

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.

Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
**About Social Scout**

Social Scout is the fastest-growing retention agency in the eCommerce industry, helping DTC brands generate more repeat purchases and increase customer lifetime value through email and SMS marketing.

We currently work with 150+ full-service retainer client accounts and are rapidly expanding into conversion rate optimization (CRO) and webpage design services.

We’re hiring a prolific, high-velocity Creative Strategist to lead our internal client acquisition pipeline. Managing over $110,000/month in internal Meta ad spend, your primary objective will be to conceptualize, script, launch, and scale high-converting B2B ad campaigns that convince eCommerce founders, CMOs, and heads of growth to hire Social Scout.

Our goal is simple: book more qualified calls, sign more clients, and accelerate our growth even further. We want to double, and eventually triple, our current ad spend as quickly as performance allows.

This role will initially focus heavily on scaling our core email and SMS marketing offer, while also helping us expand into new acquisition funnels for CRO and related services.

We’re looking for someone who can operate at high velocity, aiming for 60+ ad variations per week, while still thinking strategically about messaging, hooks, angles, creative formats, testing, and performance.

**Compensation & Role Details**

* Highly competitive salary.
* Full-time (40 hours per week) and fully remote.
* You must be set up and hired as a contractor.
* Fluent English required (written and spoken).
* A minimum five hour overlap between 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST.

**The Role**

As a Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of creative concepts, rapid content production, and ad account execution. You won't just be writing briefs, you will actively write scripts, direct existing video footage (studio recordings, founder clips, B-roll, client interviews), manage UGC creator relationships, collaborate with video editors, and directly launch campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager.

This is a high-volume, performance-first role built for someone who understands how to use creative as the primary targeting lever in B2B and performance marketing.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* High-Velocity Scripting & Concepting: Develop 60 ad creative concepts/variations weekly using modular testing frameworks (swapping hooks, CTAs, angles, and visual formats) tailored for Meta.
* Content & Production Management: Utilize our existing media library (founder studio footage, client interviews, B-roll) to brief video editors. Sourcing and managing relationships with external UGC creators and B2B actors as needed.
* Meta Campaign Setup & Launch: Upload, set up, and launch ad creatives directly inside Meta Ads Manager, ensuring accurate naming conventions, headlines, primary text, and campaign setups.
* Performance Analysis & Testing: Analyze front-end metrics (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPL) and down-funnel performance. Continually iterate on winning angles and eliminate underperforming creative assets.
* Service Ecosystem Synergy: Work closely with our email marketing and upcoming CRO/webpage design teams to ensure ad messaging seamlessly connects with landing pages and backend nurture flows.
* Platform Expansion Strategy: Lead initial efforts on Meta while laying the foundation to repurpose winning creative formats into future channels like LinkedIn and Google.

### **What You Bring**

* 2+ years of hands-on experience as a Performance Creative Strategist focused heavily on Meta Ads.
* Proven track record writing scripts and concepts for short-form video (Reels/UGC) and static graphics that drive direct-response conversions.
* Experience in high-volume creative testing environments, capable of managing asset pipelines and briefing video editors efficiently.
* Hands-on proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, including campaign creation, ad upload, ad copy execution, and metric tracking.
* Strong understanding of creative analytics: You know how to read Hook Rates (3-second view rates), Hold Rates, and CTRs to diagnose why an ad is winning or losing.
* Organized workflow management: Comfortable managing raw footage libraries, creator briefs, and editing queues without letting details slip through the cracks.

### **Who You Are**

* A natural storyteller who understands psychology: You know how to stop the scroll, address pain points, and communicate complex value propositions clearly and persuasively.
* Data-driven and volume-minded: You understand that scaling on Meta requires constant creative iteration and rapid testing rather than relying on a single "perfect" ad.
* Detail-obsessed: From ad copy formatting and UTM links to upload settings in Meta Ads Manager, you hold high standards for accuracy and quality assurance.
* Proactive and execution-focused: You don't wait for footage to be delivered—you review existing raw assets, pull client interviews, write scripts, and push campaigns live efficiently.

### **Why Social Scout?**

* High-impact position: Own the flagship creative production process driving $110k+/month in Meta ad spend across a growing portfolio of 150+ clients.
* Access to strong creative assets: Work with dedicated studio footage, head of growth recordings, client interviews, and in-house video editing support.
* Career growth: Opportunity to shape and lead our expanding paid social department as we scale into new platforms (LinkedIn, Google) and offer cross-channel CRO services.
* A fast-moving, supportive culture: Collaborative environment with proven marketers who celebrate wins and value performance-driven creativity.

description:
**About the company**

### **Tomorrow University: A Next-Generation University for Impactful Careers**

Education is the most powerful lever for driving the transition to a sustainable society. That’s why we’ve built a university dedicated to educating and empowering the change-makers of tomorrow. We offer accredited degree programs designed to equip learners with 21st-century competencies while providing access to a world-class network of experts to maximize their impact.

As a remote-first institution, we use technology and AI to enable flexible, personalized learning - accessible from anywhere in the world.

We are proud to be the first EdTech startup in Europe with a fully state-recognized university license and to be ranked among the **Top 20 EdTech startups globally**.

### **Our Inspiration**

We believe that transforming education requires rethinking how we teach. At Tomorrow University, we move beyond the traditional, teacher-centered approach and embrace **a student-centric learning model**. Our goal is to equip learners with the essential skills and mindset needed to create global impact, supported by a vast network of change-makers.

### **Our Mission**

At Tomorrow University, we leverage **science and technology** to enhance learning while fostering a global community for continuous growth and impact. Our students learn by **applying their knowledge to real-world challenges** and engaging with world-class educators, mentors, and partners from around the globe.

**Be aware that all of our positions are completely Remote but our working hours are Central European Time (+/- 2h)**

**About the role**

The marketing team works across three growth levers: **create demand, acquire demand, convert demand.** Four people own that work between them. **You own create demand.**

Your job is to make more of the right people want a Tomorrow University degree.

Choosing a degree is a slow, expensive, high-trust decision. People discover us, come back weeks later, attend an event, compare options, worry about cost, and take time to decide. Your work gives them a reason to pay attention and helps build the confidence to take the next step.

You set the content strategy and produce much of the work yourself. You decide what we say, who we say it to, which formats and channels we use, and what is worth testing. Most weeks, that also means writing, filming, editing, or building the asset.

You have support. Part-time creators help increase output once we know what works, and our designer supports the work that needs stronger craft or brand treatment.

We are looking for someone who likes making things, putting them in market, and learning from the response. The goal is consistent demand creation, with a clear view of which ideas, messages, and formats are actually working.

What You'll Own

Make people want this degree

* Develop the content strategy across programs, markets, paid, organic, and social. You decide the ideas, the messages, the proof points behind them, and which audiences they are for.
* Turn our positioning into creative that people understand and remember. That means knowing how to express an idea through copy, design, photography, video, or a combination of them.
* Lead the creative for program launches and seasonal campaigns from first idea to execution.

Work at strategy level and make the work yourself

This is a small startup, so the role moves between strategy and execution all the time.

* You write exceptionally well and can take an idea from rough concept to finished asset yourself.
* You are comfortable designing in Figma or Canva, shooting photography, filming and editing video, and producing short-form content for social and paid. You also know when a stronger piece needs a specialist.
* Freelancers and creators are there to support and scale the work, but you need enough creative range and judgement to direct them well.
* Use AI image and video tools where they are genuinely useful, alongside more traditional production.

Own social content strategy and creation

You own what we say on social and what we make for it.

* Set the social content strategy, generate the ideas, write the posts, develop recurring formats, and brief UGC creators.
* Produce the core content yourself and work with freelancers or creators where additional production is needed.
* Work closely with our part-time Social Media Coordinator, who manages scheduling, publishing, engagement, commenting, and the day-to-day running of the channels.
* Build content with both organic and paid use in mind where it makes sense.

Test ideas and build on what works

* Work with Performance Marketing on a regular creative testing rhythm across messages, concepts, formats, and audiences.
* Keep a clear record of which angles work by program and market so future campaigns start with evidence.
* Decide what to test next, stop producing ideas that are not working, and develop the ones that are.
* Bring the useful learnings into the weekly review, including both the strong performers and the ideas that did not land.

What You Bring

* 7+ years in performance creative, growth marketing, content, or social. You have spent a meaningful part of that time making the work yourself.
* You are an excellent writer across hooks, scripts, ad copy, captions, and campaign messaging, and you know how to change the writing when the format changes.
* Comfortable shooting and editing yourself, whether that is on a phone, a camera, or whatever else the idea needs.
* You can design well enough in Figma or Canva to make strong static assets without waiting on a designer for every piece.
* **Creative testing is part of how you work.** You can isolate a variable, read the result properly, and decide what to change next.
* You know how to direct creators, freelancers, coordinators, and designers once an idea is working. Clear briefs and useful feedback matter more than process.
* AI image and video tools are already part of your production workflow, and you have a good sense of when they help and when they do not.
* You are comfortable being measured on outcomes beyond reach or engagement, including applications and enrolled students.
You believe education can change lives.  

  

Nice to have, not required:

* You speak German.
* You have worked in higher education, edtech, or another category with a long purchase decision.
* You have run creator or UGC programs.
* You can do motion design or advanced video editing.
* You are a strong photographer.
* You have worked on performance creative in a regulated category.

**What Matters to Us**

We’re looking for people who thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment. These traits are especially important to us:

* **Ownership & Independence** – You take initiative and get things done
* **Collaborative Mindset** – You enjoy working across teams and disciplines
* **Clear & Thoughtful Communication** – You know how to adapt your message to different audiences
* **Integrity, Curiosity & Growth** – You’re honest, open-minded, and always looking to learn
* **Proactivity & Drive** – You bring energy and momentum to your work
* **Commitment to Execution** – You don’t just dream big—you make things happen
* **Passion for Sustainability, Entrepreneurship & Technology** – You care deeply about building a better future

**Perks & Benefits**

**Grow with us**

At Tomorrow University, we foster lifelong learning. You’ll have access to our innovative programs and be part of a culture that encourages continuous growth, personally and professionally.

**Travel the world together**

Twice a year, we bring the whole team together for a week-long Workation somewhere in Europe, think bonding, brainstorming, and big ideas in beautiful places.

**Time to recharge**

You’ll get **25 vacation days** per year, plus public holidays based on your location.

**Ready to shape the future of education and make an impact? Join us and help reimagine how we learn, grow, and build a better tomorrow.**

At Tomorrow University, we believe in your potential, not your paperwork. Degrees are great, but your *drive* matters even more

title: Creative Lead (Social & UGC)
description:
**Who we are**
==============

Creative Milkshake is a remote-first performance creative agency. We make scroll-stopping short-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok - high-volume, fast-moving, and built to convert.

We’re a close-knit team of ~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing - in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.

Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.

**The role**
============

We make a lot of content. Across a portfolio of DTC clients, our studio shoots and edits dozens of UGC ads every week. Most of it is good. Some of it is great. And the difference between good and great is specific: the hook that actually stops the scroll, the edit that holds attention, the subtle thing that makes a piece of content feel native rather than forced. That's what this role is about.

We’re looking for a Creative Lead (Social & UGC) to be the final creative eye before work reaches clients. You'll review raw footage, storyboards, and final edits, and give the kind of specific, hands-on feedback that actually improves the work rather than just flags problems.

You’ve made content yourself. You’ve been on set, you’ve been in the edit, you know what it takes to make a 15-second video that does something to the person watching it. You bring that maker's instinct to a quality and creative leadership role, and you use it to raise the bar across a whole studio.

**Timezone preference**
=======================

For this role, we're only considering candidates based in +/ 3 hrs CET time zone.

**What you’ll do**
==================

**Hold the creative quality bar**
---------------------------------

* Review storyboards, raw footage when necessary, and final edits before they go to clients
* Be the quality gate: if something isn’t ready, you say so clearly, and you explain exactly what needs to change and why
* Build and maintain the ad example library, creative checklists, and “what good looks like” guides that codify your instinct into something the whole team can learn from
* Spot recurring patterns: editing habits that aren't working, storyboard mistakes that keep appearing, hooks that aren't landing. Address them at the root, not ad by ad

**Give hands-on creative direction in post**
--------------------------------------------

* Review raw footage after shoots and provide clear direction on what’s usable, what’s not, and what to do differently next time
* Give precise editing feedback to our video editors: pacing, cut points, text overlays, sound design, the craft layer that turns a decent edit into something that performs
* Understand design fundamentals well enough to give direction on static assets, thumbnail frames, and text treatments: what reads on a phone screen and what doesn't
* Know what a 9:16 UGC ad needs to do in the first 2 seconds, and be able to articulate it in a way an editor can act on immediately

**Support production with a creative eye**
------------------------------------------

* Review storyboards before shoots and flag what isn’t shootable as written, what talent or set requirements are missing, and where the brief and the concept have drifted
* Give production the creative context they need to go into a shoot prepared: what angles matter, what the edit is going to need, what “good” looks like for this format and this brand
* Periodically join shoots at the Amsterdam studio (+-3 times a year) when creative stakes are high or a new format is being tested
* Over time, help build a visual reference library for the studio: what set styles, lighting setups, and shooting approaches produce the most versatile footage

**Drive platform and content intelligence**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain a genuine, current relationship with TikTok, Meta, and emerging short-form platforms: scrolling with a critical eye, not just awareness
* Curate a regular inspiration feed for the team: specific content examples with notes on why they work, what the craft decisions are, and how we could produce something similar in our studio
* Know the difference between a format worth adopting and a trend worth skipping, and be able to make the case either way
* Bring fresh creative references when the team’s output starts feeling formulaic or dated

**Build the team’s creative instinct**
--------------------------------------

* Give Creative Strategists feedback on CSPs and scripts that builds their creative eye over time, not just fixes the brief in front of them
* Run regular creative review sessions and inspiration shares that create a shared language for what “good” means at Creative Milkshake
* Be the person the team brings work to when they're not sure if it's there yet, and give them an answer they can trust

**Own CM’s creative identity externally**
-----------------------------------------

* Approve CM's own social content and website portfolio: what we put out about ourselves should reflect the standard we hold for clients
* Help define and document CM’s creative POV over time: the format instincts, the aesthetic signatures, the things that make our content recognizably ours

**Who you are**
===============

We’re not filtering on titles. We're looking for a specific type of person: someone with a sharp creative eye for what works on social, who wants to use that experience to raise the quality of an entire studio's output.

* 3–7 years of hands-on experience in video production, editing, content creation, or a creative role at a social-first agency or DTC brand. You've made things, not just briefed them
* A genuine, current feel for short-form social content: you scroll TikTok and Meta with a critical eye, you notice what’s working before it’s obvious, and you can describe the craft decisions behind it in specific terms
* Ability to understand paid media and performance marketing reports to inform creative decisions
* Real editing experience, or close enough collaboration with editors, that you speak the language of the edit
* Enough on-set or production experience to spot when a storyboard isn’t going to translate, and know what to do about it
* The ability to tell a good ad from a great one in seconds, and explain why in a way the person who made it can actually use
* Feedback that is specific, timestamped, and producible, not vague creative notes that leave people guessing
* High EQ: you can give honest creative feedback without damaging the confidence or the relationship of the person on the other end
* Comfortable with ambiguity and pace: we're building systems while operating at volume
* Fluent in English, confident presenting creative rationale to clients when needed

**Backgrounds that tend to produce this person**
================================================

There’s no single path. People who are great at this role often come from one of these places:

* A video editor or post-production lead who has developed a strong creative eye for social, and wants to work upstream on quality rather than just executing edits
* A UGC creator or content creator who has built a real, granular understanding of what performs and why, and wants to bring that instinct to a studio environment at scale
* A creative producer who sits between strategy and production, has strong taste, and wants to formalise that into a quality leadership role
* A social content lead or in-house creative at a DTC brand who has been hands-on with short-form video and wants to take their creative judgement further

**What they all share: they’ve made things, they have taste, and they can teach it.**

**You’ll thrive here if…**
==========================

* You get genuinely excited about the craft of short-form video: the hook, the cut, the text timing, the sound. You find it hard to watch a mediocre ad without knowing what you'd fix
* You want a role where your creative instinct directly improves what goes out the door every week
* You’re energised by the challenge of holding a high standard at volume: lots of content, lots of clients, fast turnarounds
* You want to shape creative culture from the inside: setting a standard, building the resources that make a team better, defining what “good” means at a growing studio
* The idea of helping a UGC studio move toward elevated social-first content over the next couple of years sounds like exactly the right moment to join

**This role isn’t for you if…**
===============================

* You’ve only worked in creative strategy or performance marketing and haven’t been hands-on with video production or editing
* Your creative background is in brand identity or traditional advertising rather than short-form, social-first content
* You prefer to stay in the strategic or conceptual space and find production and editing detail less interesting
* You’re primarily looking for a people-management role. Your influence here comes through creative expertise, not team size

**What we offer**
=================

* Creative Milkshake Stipends (mental health, healthcare & internet)
* Time Off: 21 days PTO + 7 Paid Sick Days; company closure: 2 weeks at year-end (estimated: December 22 – January 5)
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Yearly Salary Review
* Long Service Incentives (starting from 2 years)

title: Performance Creative Strategist
description:
ABOUT US
  
  
Reach Digital is an AI-first performance marketing agency helping eCommerce and digital product brands scale through creative, paid media, and landing pages. We are a true growth partner - going deep with brands to become integrated into their marketing team. We drive real growth by combining data, testing, and new ideas.
  
  
We're a fully remote team of creatives, editors, and growth strategists. We care about the work, and care about being the best at what we do.
  
  
THE ROLE
  
  
As a Creative Strategist at Reach, you own the creative end-to-end. You'll do the research, develop ad angles, write hooks, and build creative briefs that our editors execute, working directly with our brand partners and growth/design teams.
  
  
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
  
  
You have 2+ years of digital marketing experience
  
  
You understand paid media and the types of content that converts
  
  
You enjoy brainstorming ad angles and concepts, then bringing them to life
  
  
You are detail-orientated, organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  
  
You're willing to learn and get better even when that means giving and receiving feedback
  
  
You are comfortable communicating learnings with both team members and clients
  
  
You're genuinely passionate about creative strategy and staying on top of what's working - you do this because you want to, not because you have to
  
  
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  
  
Analyzing performance, brainstorming ad angles and hook variations, and writing new briefs weekly for the editing team to produce
  
  
Owning the creative strategy for your brand partners, including a living strategy doc that tracks angles, performance, and what to test next
  
  
Staying current on platform trends, winning ad formats, and policy changes, and translating that into testable concepts for your accounts
  
  
Working with 3-5 brand partners at a time, with a focus on going deep into their creative and building new winning ads
  
  
WHAT TO EXPECT FROM US
  
  
**Growth:** We invest in the people who invest in the work. Expect regular creative reviews, direct feedback, and room to grow into senior roles as Reach scales.
  
  
**Weekly Calls & Creative Training:** Weekly team check-ins, creative reviews and training sessions. Calls are typically held between 12pm–6pm EST on weekdays.
  
  
Generous PTO and benefits policy
  
  
Fully remote role (working US hours)
  
  
Competitive compensation in USD
  
  
The Hiring Process
  
  
All candidates will go through a 15-minute questionnaire. Following this, top candidates will be given a culture fit interview before being given a paid, take-home assignment.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing production, creative execution, and performance analytics, ensuring that creatives are produced efficiently, tested systematically, and scaled based on data and results - not subjective taste.

  
Requirements:  
  

Required Experience & Skills:

* Strong understanding of performance marketing and paid acquisition channels
* Conversational English (ability to communicate effectively with international teams)
* Hands-on experience working with key metrics: CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS
* Experience managing creative testing, iteration, and scaling
* Ability to manage production pipelines and multiple creative iterations
* Data-driven mindset with a strong focus on efficiency and results

Nice-to-have:

* Experience using AI tools for creative production or optimization
* Experience working with the Tier-1 markets
* Structured thinking

  
Brand:
  
TripleTen

* Own the full lifecycle of marketing creatives within the Marketing Production team
* Translate performance and acquisition goals into clear creative briefs and hypotheses
* Oversee production of marketing assets (video, static, UGC) for paid channels
* Analyze creative performance and identify opportunities for iteration and scaling
* Work with key metrics to guide creative decisions
* Build scalable creative frameworks and variation systems
* Ensure fast and predictable production timelines aligned with marketing needs
* Collaborate closely with UA team and content production team
* Document creative learnings, best practices, and performance insights

  
What we can offer you:
  

* Remote and flexible cooperation.
* Convenient digital office with collaboration tools like Slack, Miro, Notion.
* Professional freedom, where we trust your experience instead of wasting each other's time and effort micromanaging.
* International team of professionals.

title: Creative Producer
description:
**TheSoul Group** is a leading creator business platform positioned at the heart of the creator economy. Our original videos, animations, and editorial stories inspire audiences in **21 languages**, across **60 platforms** and **20 websites**.

Together with our network of talented creators, we reach over **5 billion followers** and generate more than **100 billion monthly views** on social media.

As a global powerhouse in digital media, we drive viral success for creators and brands worldwide through a wide range of services, leveraging our expertise in content production, distribution, localization, and social media management. We’re the creators behind global phenomena such as **5-Minute Crafts** and **Bright Side**.

We’re a dynamic, remote-first global team, fostering award-winning creativity, a no-red-tape approach, and great vibes!

We are looking to connect with experienced **Creative Producers** to lead creative content production for external clients and brands.

In these projects, you may manage the creative production process from brief to delivery, working directly with clients to understand their objectives, brand guidelines, and audience needs and translating them into effective social media content.

You will collaborate closely with creative and production teams, oversee the quality and consistency of deliverables, and help ensure that projects meet both client expectations and creative standards across a variety of formats and social platforms.

**Responsibilities:**

Depending on the scope and requirements of individual projects, responsibilities may include:

* Manage end-to-end production of video, static, and other social media content for external clients.
* Work directly with clients to understand their business objectives, creative needs, brand positioning, guidelines, and expectations.
* Translate client requirements into clear creative briefs and production plans.
* Guide designers, video editors, creators, and other production team members throughout the creative process.
* Develop and refine creative concepts that support clients’ brands and social media objectives.
* Oversee quality control across creative deliverables, ensuring that visuals, videos, and copy meet both client requirements and internal creative standards.
* Manage production timelines, priorities, workloads, and resource allocation across projects.
* Maintain consistent quality while supporting a high volume of creative output.
* Present creative solutions, communicate project updates, and incorporate client feedback throughout the production process.
* Supervise and support creative teams, helping them deliver against project requirements and creative expectations.
* Support the hiring, onboarding, and mentoring of production and creative team members when required.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Track production budgets, estimate costs, and support efficient use of project resources.
* Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, creative processes, and overall team efficiency.

  
**Requirements**  
  
**Strong Requirements:**

* **2+ years of experience in creative production for external clients as a Producer.** Experience working with major international brands is a strong advantage.
* **Hands-on video production experience**, with a background in filming, editing, motion design, design, or another relevant production discipline.
* **2+ years of experience leading creative teams**, with a track record of scaling creative output and improving creative performance.

**Requirements:**

* Strong understanding of the end-to-end creative production process, from client brief and concept development through production and final delivery.
* Experience translating client objectives, brand guidelines, and feedback into clear creative direction and actionable briefs.
* Strong understanding of social media content and the ability to adapt creative approaches to different platforms, audiences, and formats.
* Experience managing multiple creative deliverables, timelines, and priorities in a fast-paced production environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including confidence working directly with clients.
* Strong creative judgment and attention to quality and detail.
* Experience producing content for international brands or multi-market audiences is highly desirable.

  
**Benefits**  

* **Flexible, Project-Based Engagement:** This is a talent-pool opportunity for potential future projects rather than a full-time position. Engagements will be offered under an independent service-provider agreement based on project needs and your relevant experience. You define your own working methods, organise your schedule independently, and contribute your expertise to clearly scoped projects. Compensation will be agreed individually based on the scope of each engagement, your experience, capabilities, and the value you bring.

* **Location Freedom:** You can deliver services from any suitable location that supports high-quality outcomes, whether that’s your home office, a co-working space, or wherever you feel most productive and inspired. What matters most is the impact you create and the reliability of your delivery.
* **Global Network and Inspiring Projects:** You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse international network of professionals across 85+ countries on projects reaching audiences around the world.
* **Smooth Collaboration and Project Support:** We provide modern collaboration platforms, clear project coordination, and streamlined processes so you can focus on producing high-impact work and bringing creative solutions to life.
* **Make a Global Impact:** Your expertise may contribute to initiatives that influence audiences worldwide and help build the next generation of digital experiences.

*We appreciate your interest in our job opportunities and our company. Our team carefully evaluates each application to identify the most suitable candidates for the role. Due to the high volume of applications received, we may not be able to respond to every applicant. However, if your qualifications align with our requirements, we will contact you to discuss the next steps in the selection process.*

description:
### **Who are we?**

We are an international Alkemy a digital consulting firm specialized in driving the evolution of the business models of large and mid-sized companies. We help our clients improve their competitiveness by connecting strategy, communication, design, technology, and data always with a practical, impact-oriented approach.

With more than 2,000 people across different countries, we work on end-to-end projects: from strategic definition to implementation, measurement, and continuous optimization. Our focus is on turning data into real business decisions, not just producing reports.

### **About the role**

We are looking to hire a **Senior Client Partner** at Alkemy, with a strong commercial mindset and proven experience in advertising, digital media, creativity, and digital transformation.

The main mission of this role will be to **generate new business among large advertisers and brands**, building trusted relationships with Marketing Directors, CMOs, Digital Directors, Media Directors, eCommerce Directors, and other key decision-makers. The goal will be to identify their needs and turn them into business opportunities across Alkemy’s different capabilities.

We are looking for someone who is **strongly sales-oriented**, with the ability to open doors, develop long-term relationships, and take a consultative approach to selling solutions that combine Media, Paid Media, creativity, content, social media, eCommerce, web, mobile, and digital transformation.

We are not simply looking for an account manager: we are looking for a profile with a **proven ability to create opportunities, develop compelling proposals, and close business**.

### **What will you do?**

##### **Build new business**

You'll own the commercial growth of your portfolio and be responsible for creating opportunities from the ground up.

* Identify and target high-value brands and advertisers.
* Build your own network of prospects and strategic relationships.
* Open doors with senior decision-makers across Marketing, Digital, Media and eCommerce.
* Develop trusted relationships with **CMO-level stakeholders** and become a credible strategic partner.
* Uncover business challenges, marketing priorities and investment opportunities.
* Lead the complete sales journey: **prospecting discovery strategy proposal negotiation close**.
* Lead pitches, presentations, RFPs and commercial negotiations.
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline and accurate sales forecast.
* Develop relationships that generate long-term **upselling and cross-selling opportunities**.

##### **Sell solutions, not services**

At Alkemy, clients don't come to us simply looking for a media plan, a website or a campaign.

They come with **business challenges**.

You'll be expected to understand those challenges and bring together the right capabilities to solve them.

Depending on the opportunity, this could mean combining:

**Media + Paid Media + Creativity + Social + Content + eCommerce + Technology + Data + AI + CX**

You'll work closely with our specialists to turn complex client needs into **compelling, integrated propositions that create real business value**.

##### **Lead strategic client conversations**

You'll operate comfortably at senior level, moving beyond tactical conversations to discuss:

* Business and growth objectives.
* Marketing and digital transformation.
* Customer acquisition and retention.
* Media investment and performance.
* Brand and customer experience.
* Data and AI opportunities.
* eCommerce and digital platforms.
* New ways of engaging consumers.

You'll understand what matters to the client and translate it into opportunities for Alkemy.

##### **Build partnerships that last**

Winning the first project is only the beginning.

You'll build relationships designed to grow over time, identifying new challenges, new stakeholders and new opportunities across the organisation.

You'll develop strategic account plans and continuously look for opportunities to expand our relationship through **upselling, cross-selling and new business**.

### **Your ecosystem at Alkemy**

You won't be selling alone. You'll work with multidisciplinary teams across:

**Media · Creative / Cosmic · Brand Experience · Social Media · Technology · eCommerce · Data & AI · CRO / CXO · Engagement & Loyalty**

Your role is to connect the dots: **bring the client challenge, bring the right people together and lead the commercial opportunity.**

### **What are we looking for?**

We're looking for a senior commercial profile with **6–10+ years of experience** in business development, sales, Client Partner, Business Director, Account Director or similar roles within the digital ecosystem.

More than a specific job title, we're interested in your track record:

* You have **successfully opened new accounts and won new business**.
* You have an established network across Marketing, Digital, Media and/or eCommerce.
* You know how to get a conversation with senior decision-makers.
* You have experience selling **digital advertising, media, creative, content, technology or digital transformation services**.
* You understand the digital advertising ecosystem: Paid Media, Paid Social, Programmatic, Display, Search and Performance.
* You can confidently discuss creativity, content, social, eCommerce and digital experience with clients.
* You have experience leading pitches, RFPs and complex commercial proposals.
* You're comfortable negotiating significant budgets and managing multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* You understand pipeline management, CRM and sales forecasting.
* You are fluent in **Spanish and professionally proficient in English**.

**Background:** AdTech&Platforms, Media Agencies, Digital & Creative Agencies, Consulting & Digital Experience

### **We’re looking for someone who is**

* **Highly commercial and results-oriented**, with a strong focus on achieving business objectives.
* A true **hunter**, with the ability and motivation to open new accounts and create opportunities from scratch.
* **Consultative**, able to understand the client’s business rather than simply sell individual services.
* Comfortable and credible when engaging with **CMOs and senior decision-makers**.
* Able to speak confidently about both **business and marketing**.
* Deeply familiar with the **digital ecosystem** and its evolving opportunities.
* Able to connect different capabilities and build **integrated, high-value solutions**.
* Comfortable working with **commercial targets, pipelines and ambitious growth objectives**.
* An excellent **presenter and negotiator**, able to influence stakeholders and lead complex conversations.
* **Proactive, autonomous and entrepreneurial**, with the drive to identify opportunities rather than wait for them to appear.

### **What do we offer you?**

At Alkemy, we work to help people develop their talent in a collaborative, demanding, and stimulating environment where ideas become reality.

* Opportunity to grow in an international company combining technology, creativity, marketing, and innovation
* Exposure to digital transformation, AI, media, CRM, and customer experience projects
* Learning and career development in business development and sales
* Dynamic, collaborative, and fast-paced environment
* Flexible working model

**Would you like to grow with us?**  
If you’re looking for an environment where analytics plays a strategic role, innovation is applied with sound judgment, and data generates real impact…

We look forward to meeting you at Alkemy.

**Loyal to our commitment with diversity and inclusion, we encourage everybody to apply, especially those belonging to underrepresented groups such as LGTBIQ+ members and those with disabilities.**

**Where your expertise is needed**  
  
AUTODOC is the largest and fastest growing auto parts ecommerce platform in Europe.  
Present across 27 countries with around 6,000 employees, AUTODOC generated revenue of over €1.8 billion in 2025, supplying more than 9.3 million active customers with its millions of vehicle parts and accessories for car, truck, and motorcycle brands.  
  
We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels a strong sense of  
impact, purpose, and belonging—whether they are working in our offices, warehouses, or remotely.  
With our headquarters in Berlin, and several offices across Europe, we are driving towards our vision  
with a clear focus on leveraging technology to build a sustainable future for mobility.  
  
Join us as we accelerate towards becoming the leading tech ecosystem in the automotive world.  
  
Catch the ride with AUTODOC!

 **Job Description**

**About the role**

AUTODOC is scaling fast, and creative vision and leadership are two of the biggest levers we have to do it well. We're hiring a Head of Creative to set the creative direction for our brand and lead the design team that brings it to life — across content, campaigns and the wider company.

In this role, you'll hold true creative ownership: translating business and brand strategy into concepts and campaigns that hold together across every market and channel, managing and developing a team of designers, and building the operating model that lets high-quality creative scale without depending on any one person.

**What you'll own**

Creative and design vision. Set the creative direction for AUTODOC's brand and communications, translating business and brand strategy into concepts, campaigns, and ideas that hold together across every market and channel.

The team and the craft. Directly manage and grow a team of graphic, brand, and motion designers — setting workload, running regular critique, and developing their skills. You'll be hands-on enough to give sharp, specific design feedback in tools like Figma or Adobe Creative Suite, not just at the concept level.

Quality at scale & operations. Build the design system, brand guidelines, and creative operating model — including briefing frameworks, prioritization processes, resource allocation, and review workflows — that let the team move fast and stay excellent across a high-volume, multi-market output.

Business partnership. Work directly with Promotions, CRM, Private Brand, Internal Comms, Performance Marketing, and Product to make sure creative resourcing and prioritization reflect what the business actually needs, while representing the creative point of view to senior stakeholders with real credibility.

Modern creative practice. Champion the use of AI and emerging design tools (such as Figma Make, Adobe Firefly, or similar) across the creative workflow — pushing speed and experimentation where it counts, while knowing where craft and human judgment stay non-negotiable.

 **Qualifications**

**What you bring**

* A design background: you've worked as a designer or art director earlier in your career, and can credibly review and direct design work, not only brand strategy or concepts.
* Proven people management experience: you've directly managed and developed a team of designers, with real responsibility for their output, growth, and workload — not just worked alongside one.
* A clear point of view: ability to present a creative position, defend it, and know when to adapt it based on business needs.
* Proven range across identity and brand systems, campaign concepts, performance and CRM creative, and motion design.
* Strong operational competence in structuring creative workflows, managing prioritization, and scaling high-volume output across complex organizations.
* Skilled at giving and receiving direct creative feedback, with experience managing a mix of resources — internal teams, freelancers, and external vendors — to keep output consistent and on brief.
* Working fluency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and AI-assisted design tools (Figma Make, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Google’s suite or similar).
* Direct experience in DE, FR, or UK markets, with the judgment to adapt campaign strategies to markets you know less well.
* Credibility with senior stakeholders, including the ability to defend creative decisions under commercial pressure.
* Professional working proficiency in English (verbal and written).

**What we offer:**

* Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
* Fast growing international company with stable employment
* Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
* Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
* Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)

* Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform

* Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
* Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)

Flexible working hours and hybrid work  

**How to apply**

title: Creative Director
description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.
  
  
We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.
  
  
Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.
  
  
We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $20B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.
  
  
If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.
  
  
****The Role****
Most B2B software looks the same. A few companies have proven it doesn't have to: brands with real taste, that people follow, wear and want to work for.
  
  
Behind every CPG brand you love is a back office nobody sees: the finance lead chasing a deduction at 11pm, the sales team planning a promotion blind, the founder watching margin leak line by line. Confido exists for them. Your job is to tell their story, and ours, so well that people who have never heard the words "trade spend" want to be part of it.
  
  
This is a principal-level role. You'll be our first creative brand hire and the keeper of how Confido looks and feels, setting the creative direction for the company and holding the final call on the craft. A new strategy and identity are underway with our agency partner, and you'll take it from a set of guidelines to a brand with a point of view: one customers share, candidates join for, and competitors quietly copy.
  
  
You'll own every place someone meets us, from the website and launches to decks, ads, events, video and the brand moments inside our product. As the work grows, you'll build and direct a bench of specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication. You'll report to our VP of Marketing and work closely with the founders.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Be the creative voice in the room. Partner with the founders and marketing leadership on how we tell our story and what the brand stands for
* Shape the brand from the ground up. Take the new identity from guidelines to a living system with a voice, a point of view and a standard people notice
* Find the story in the numbers. Turn customer outcomes, like $500K recouped for Feastables or revenue doubled with the same finance team at DUDE Wipes, into campaigns, films and stories people remember
* Make the invisible visible. Put the people, shelves, pallets and trucks of CPG at the centre of how we show up, never just another dashboard screenshot
* Own every surface. confido.com, launches, sales and customer decks, ads, social, email and the brand moments inside our product
* Create moments in the room. Concept and direct our booths, customer dinners and owned events so people leave talking about them. We care deeply about unreasonable hospitality - people should feel that across every experiential surface.
* Build your bench. Hire and direct specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication, with the templates, intake and asset library that let them do their best work
* Make brand and product one. Partner with our product design team so every touchpoint feels like the same company

****What We're Looking For****

* 8+ years in brand design, art direction or creative direction, in-house, at an agency, or both, including time leading brand for a company or major client
* You're a storyteller first. You can take a complex, unglamorous idea and make people feel something about it
* A portfolio with a brand system you built or scaled, and work you're proud to show anyone
* Taste you can defend. You know the difference between good and world class
* Range: you can move from identity and web to a sales deck, a booth and a photo shoot in the same week
* Hands-on craft in Figma. You sweat the kerning and what the work does for the business
* You own work from concept to production, including vendors, printers, fabricators and budgets
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and speed, communicate clearly, and can hold an idea through founder and sales feedback

****Nice to Have****

* Brand experience at a B2B software or fintech company known for its design
* Experience working with or for CPG brands
* Motion design and video editing
* Designing and building websites in a no-code tool
* Experience leading designers or managing freelancers and agencies
* AI tools in your creative workflow, used as a multiplier rather than a gimmick

****🌴 Perks + Benefits****

* Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
* Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
* Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
* Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
* 401(k) through Vestwell
* Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
* Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
* Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

*Confido provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*
Compensation Range: $230K - $270K

title: Head of Brand Design and Creative
description:
**Our mission**
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
  
  
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
  
  
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
  
  
Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

title: Creative director
description:
This is a new Creative Director role with the opportunity to shape the creative direction of an established global technology company. You’ll set the creative vision, help build the team and infrastructure to deliver it, and turn highly technical products and ideas into compelling visual stories for audiences around the world.

**Position description**

As Creative Director, you’ll lead the creative vision and strategy for a global technology company entering an important new stage of its brand evolution. You’ll shape how the company shows up across B2C and B2B markets, helping create a more distinctive, premium visual identity while building a cohesive global approach to creative.

This is a new role, and you’ll initially be a hands-on creative leader, with the opportunity to help build the team, processes, and external partnerships needed to support the company’s growth. Reporting directly to the CMO and GM, you’ll collaborate closely with executive leadership and product management to turn complex products and ideas into compelling brand experiences for audiences around the world.

This is a full-time, direct hire position—the successful candidate will join the company directly. The role is onsite in the Los Angeles area. During the first six months, the Creative Director will travel to the company’s APAC factories to gain a firsthand understanding of manufacturing processes and products.

**Why this opportunity?**

* Lead a major brand evolution with the opportunity to influence how a global technology company presents itself to the world.
* Shape both the creative vision and the organization, processes, and partnerships that bring it to life.
* Develop creative work spanning multiple products, audiences, markets, and global campaigns.

**Activities**

* Set and lead the company’s global creative vision and strategy across business units and markets.
* Build, structure, and scale a global creative team and establish effective workflows and approval processes.
* Lead relationships with external production agencies, including budgets, negotiations, schedules, and international productions.
* Create a cohesive visual approach across product categories, campaigns, launches, and markets.
* Partner with executive leadership and product management to translate complex products and technical concepts into compelling creative.
* Balance ambitious creative ideas with production schedules, multi-market requirements, budgets, and business priorities.
* Travel regularly to collaborate with internal stakeholders, customers, and partners. Develop creative work spanning multiple products

**Skills and qualifications**

Need to have

* 10+ years of progressive creative experience, including significant experience in a Creative Director role.
* Experience leading global creative teams and/or managing large-scale agency relationships and budgets.
* Portfolio demonstrating brand transformation, global campaign execution, and development of scalable creative operations.
* Strong operational leadership and experience establishing workflows that support high-quality creative production at global scale.
* Experience developing creative for established global brands, with a portfolio demonstrating a strong visual point of view across products, campaigns, and brand experiences.
* Ability and willingness to travel regularly.
* Located in the L.A. area or willing to relocate. A relocation budget is available.

Nice to have

* Experience developing creative for consumer-facing brands with highly designed physical products.

title: Creative Director - Consumer Print Global Marketing
description:
**Description -**
**ROLE PURPOSE**
You are a creative leader first.
  
  
You have exceptional taste and a clear point of view on what great work looks like. You can move seamlessly from defining a bold brand platform to shaping the details of execution without losing sight of either.
  
  
You believe creativity is a growth engine. You create work that is culturally relevant, emotionally resonant, and commercially effective, building brands, driving demand, and delivering business impact.
  
  
You are endlessly curious, drawing inspiration from culture, technology, and industries far beyond your own. You bring fresh thinking, new formats, and innovative approaches that challenge convention, create differentiation, and unlock growth opportunities.
  
  
You are ambitious, intellectually curious, and comfortable challenging the status quo. Most importantly, you know how to build an environment where talented people can do the best work of their careers.
  
  
We are looking for an exceptional Creative Director to define and lead the creative vision for our Consumer and SMB Print business including hardware, supplies, subscriptions, solutions, and digital services.
  
  
This is a high-impact leadership role requiring someone who can navigate diverse audiences, buying journeys, business models, and channel ecosystems. You will bring the creative rigor of a leading consumer brand together with the commercial acumen of a modern growth marketer who understands how consumers and small businesses discover, evaluate, purchase, and remain loyal.
  
  
You will be responsible for making Consumer Print more relevant, distinctive, and desirable, ensuring the brand shows up with a consistent and compelling voice wherever customers engage with us.
  
  
You will translate consumer insights and business priorities into powerful creative platforms and ensure flawless execution across markets, channels, and touchpoints. You will lead internal teams and agency partners, raise the creative bar, and build a modern creative organization capable of delivering both breakthrough brand ideas and high-performing content at scale.
  
  
The role spans the full consumer ecosystem, from brand and integrated campaigns to social, content, e-commerce, DTC, and retail experiences.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Define creative vision and build brand platform
  
  

* Set the overall creative vision and strategy for consumer and SMB print.
* Translate consumer insight, cultural trends and business priorities into distinctive creative platforms.
* Develop ideas that change how consumers think about print and what enables them to create, do and enjoy.
* Establish a clear and differentiated creative expression across markets and consumer touchpoints.
* Ensure creative is rooted in a deep understanding of consumers rather than product features alone.

Lead creative excellence
  
  

* Develop breakthrough creative ideas that drive both brand equity and commercial outcomes, including consideration, conversion, loyalty, and advocacy.
* Continuously identify and adapt best-in-class creative practices from other industries, brands, and cultural spaces to inspire innovation and differentiation.
* Own the integrated creative across ad spots, digital, social, content, retail and e-commerce.
* Set the creative bar and provide clear, inspiring direction to internal teams and agencies.
* Challenge briefs and agency thinking to deliver stronger, more distinctive work.
* Ensure consistency of the brand while allowing creative to flex appropriately by audience, channel and market.
* Develop creative approaches that work across retail media, retailer content, product pages, promotions and in-store experiences.
* Build a test-and-learn culture: implement campaign effectiveness measurement frameworks (brand tracking, awareness/consideration, sales uplift) across both audiences and apply learnings iteratively.
* Explore AI and emerging creative technologies to improve quality, speed and scale.

Build the creative organization
  
  

* Build a high-performance team culture characterized by consumer obsession, creative ambition, analytical rigor, and collaborative execution.
* Own succession planning, talent development, and hiring to ensure the team has the capabilities required for long-term success.
* Develop a team that combines creative courage with business accountability, encouraging the people to think boldly while maintaining a clear focus on outcomes and return on investment.
* Build strong creative partnerships with agencies and other creative partners.

Partner across marketing
  
  

* Work closely with Brand, Insights, Strategy and Product Marketing, Performance, Media, and Sales.
* Partner with the Performance Marketing Senior Manager to ensure creative and performance work as complementary disciplines.
* Bring creative thinking into commercial and consumer growth priorities.
* Act as the senior creative voice within the consumer marketing organization.
* Present creative strategy and work confidently to senior leadership.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Significant experience as a Creative Director, Executive Creative Director or equivalent senior creative leader.
* Proven track record of creating distinctive consumer brand work.
* Proven ability to deliver exceptional creative work while effectively managing budgets and resources.
* Experience leading integrated campaigns across digital, social and traditional channels.
* Strong experience managing creative agencies and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience working across DTC, e-commerce and/or retail environments.
* Exceptional conceptual and strategic creative thinking.
* Strong understanding of consumer behavior and cultural trends.
* Experience working across multiple markets and geographies.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills.
* Experience in consumer technology, electronics, DTC, e-commerce or retail.
* Experience working for a globally recognized consumer brand.
* Experience transforming creative organizations or operating models.
* Experience using AI and new technologies to accelerate creative development.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related discipline — required.

Success measures
  
  

* Strength and distinctiveness of the consumer brand
* Contribution of creative work to revenue growth and category expansion.
* Consistency and quality across DTC and retail touchpoints
* Creative effectiveness and quality
* Speed and scalability of creative production
* Adoption of new creative capabilities and ways of working

description:

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
