title: Podcast Producer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an organized, creative and hands-on **Podcast** **Producer** to lead the end-to-end production and delivery of Alea’s two podcasts.

The Podcast Producer will be responsible for the complete operational process, from initial planning and pre-production through recording, post-production, approval and final publication. The role will ensure that every episode is produced on time, meets Alea’s quality standards and supports the company’s communications and brand objectives.

Working closely with the **Head of PR & Communications**, the **Podcast** **Producer** will help define the strategy, positioning, editorial direction and distribution approach for both podcasts. This person will then translate that strategy into a structured production plan and manage its day-to-day execution.

This role is ideal for someone who combines editorial judgement, project management and technical production skills and who is comfortable coordinating guests, managing recordings, reviewing edits and overseeing publication across multiple platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1.** **Podcast** **Strategy and Editorial Planning**

* Define the strategy, positioning, objectives and target audience for both podcasts in collaboration with the Head of PR & Communications.
* Contribute ideas for themes, episode topics, formats, guests and editorial series.
* Develop and manage an editorial calendar and release schedule for both podcasts.
* Ensure podcast topics and guests are aligned with Alea’s brand positioning, communications priorities and business objectives.
* Research relevant industry topics, trends and conversations to identify new editorial opportunities.
* Prepare episode concepts and proposals for review and approval by the Head of PR & Communications.
* Regularly review the performance and direction of both podcasts and recommend strategic improvements.

### **2. Pre-production**

* Manage the complete pre-production process for every episode.
* Research topics, guests and relevant background information.
* Identify and coordinate potential guests in collaboration with the Head of PR & Communications and other stakeholders.
* Manage guest invitations, confirmations, calendars and all pre-recording communications.
* Prepare episode briefs, scripts, interview structures, talking points and run-of-show documents.
* Organize recording schedules, locations and required resources.
* Coordinate studios, external production partners or technical suppliers when needed.
* Confirm that recording equipment, software, lighting, sound and other technical requirements are ready before each session.
* Brief hosts, guests and relevant stakeholders before recording.
* Ensure all necessary permissions, consent forms and content approvals are obtained.

### **3. Recording and Live Production**

* Lead and coordinate each recording session, ensuring the process runs smoothly from start to finish.
* Set up or supervise cameras, microphones, lighting and recording software.
* Perform technical checks before every recording.
* Direct hosts and guests during the session when required.
* Monitor audio and video quality throughout the recording.
* Follow the agreed episode structure while allowing space for natural and engaging conversations.
* Identify strong moments, quotes and potential promotional clips during the recording.
* Resolve operational or technical issues quickly and efficiently.
* Ensure all recorded material is correctly saved, backed up and organized after each session.

### **4. Post-production and Quality Control**

* Manage the full post-production process for every episode.
* Edit or coordinate the editing of audio and video content.
* Review all edits and provide clear feedback to internal or external editors.
* Ensure the final episode has strong pacing, narrative flow and consistent audio and video quality.
* Coordinate the addition of intros, outros, music, graphics, subtitles and other branded elements.
* Identify and prepare the strongest moments for trailers, teasers and promotional clips.
* Ensure every episode follows Alea’s brand guidelines and editorial standards.
* Manage the internal review and approval process with the Head of PR & Communications.
* Complete a final quality check before publication, including audio, video, titles, descriptions, links, subtitles and visual assets.
* Maintain an organized archive of raw recordings, project files, final episodes and supporting materials.

### **5. Publication and Distribution**

* Manage the publication of each episode across the relevant podcast and video platforms.
* Upload and publish episodes on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, Audible, YouTube and any other selected distribution channels.
* Prepare accurate and engaging episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps and supporting copy.
* Coordinate thumbnails, cover images and other visual assets with the Design team.
* Ensure episodes are correctly categorized, tagged and optimized for discoverability.
* Coordinate publication dates and promotional activity with the Head of PR & Communications and Social Media & Content Manager.
* Verify that every episode is published correctly and is accessible across all relevant platforms.
* Update or correct published content when necessary.
* Ensure podcast information and episodes are properly featured on alea.com when relevant.

### **6. Promotional Content Coordination**

* Identify the strongest quotes, insights and moments from each episode for promotional use.
* Create or coordinate trailers, teasers, audiograms and short-form video clips.
* Provide the Social Media & Content Manager with the materials, context and key messages needed to promote each episode.
* Collaborate on the preparation of an episode-specific promotional plan.
* Ensure all promotional assets are delivered before the agreed publication date.
* Coordinate with the Design team on thumbnails, templates, graphics and other branded materials.
* Support the repurposing of podcast episodes into articles, social media posts and other communication formats.

### **7. Production and Stakeholder Management**

* Own and maintain the production workflow for both podcasts.
* Coordinate hosts, guests, internal teams, studios and external suppliers.
* Create clear timelines and ensure all milestones and publication deadlines are met.
* Keep the Head of PR & Communications informed about progress, risks, delays and required decisions.
* Manage feedback and approvals efficiently to avoid production bottlenecks.
* Maintain production documentation, episode trackers, guest information and content archives.
* Monitor external production costs and resources when applicable.
* Identify opportunities to make the production process more efficient, scalable and consistent.

### **8. Performance Analysis and Optimization**

* Track podcast performance across the relevant distribution and video platforms.
* Monitor metrics such as downloads, plays, views, watch time, audience retention, completion rate and subscriber growth.
* Analyse performance by podcast, episode, topic, guest and content format.
* Prepare regular performance reports with key findings and actionable recommendations.
* Report results and insights to the Head of PR & Communications.
* Use audience and performance data to improve topics, formats, episode duration, production and distribution.
* Monitor podcast trends, competitors and industry benchmarks to identify opportunities for growth.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least **2–3 years of experience** in podcast, audio, video, broadcast or digital content production.
* Demonstrable experience managing the complete podcast production process, from pre-production to publication.
* Experience recording and editing professional audio and video content.
* Hands-on knowledge of microphones, cameras, lighting, recording software and editing tools.
* Experience with podcast hosting and distribution platforms, as well as YouTube Studio.
* Strong editorial judgement and storytelling skills.
* Ability to prepare briefs, scripts, interview structures and production documents.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills.

description:
* REQ-10121941
* 29/09/2026
* Change Execution
* Madrid, Spain
* ING Bank

  

**At ING we are looking for Business Lead Insurance**

  
  

**Your role and work environment**

  
  

We are looking for a **talented and enthusiastic Business Lead to join our Insurance Tribe**.

The Insurance Tribe has a clear mission: to **make ING the go-to place for our customers' protection needs**. We are building a different way of doing insurance, creating propositions that are simple, transparent and truly valuable for our customers while contributing to ING's sustainable growth and distributed through best-in-class digital experiences.

As Business Lead Insurance, you will be responsible for shaping, growing and transforming our core insurance business, including Home, Life and Payment Protection Insurance (PPI).

Beyond managing and optimizing the current portfolio, you will play a key role in defining ING Spain's future insurance business strategy. This includes identifying new protection opportunities and product categories, designing customer value propositions, leading insurer selection and Request for Proposal (RfP) processes, negotiating partnerships, and overseeing the end-to-end setup and launch of new products and business models. You will be expected to combine strategic vision with flawless execution, helping ING continuously evolve its protection offering while delivering sustainable growth and customer value.

  

You will own both **today's performance and tomorrow's growth agenda**, balancing portfolio management with the development of the next generation of insurance propositions for ING customers.

This is not a traditional insurance role. You will combine strategy, commercial development, partnership management, product innovation and execution. You will **work across the entire value chain,** connecting customers, insurers, distribution channels, analytics, operations and technology teams to accelerate growth and build the next generation of protection propositions.

You will act as the **senior representative of your products** across the organization and externally, managing relationships with insurance partners, ING Headquarters and senior stakeholders across the bank. You will be expected to influence decision-making, align multiple interests and build strong partnerships that accelerate business growth.

In addition, you will **lead and develop a team of business strategy professionals**, creating an environment where talent can thrive, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance, while ensuring the team contributes effectively to the Tribe's strategic objectives.

You will also be responsible for defining and **achieving the commercial objectives** of the insurance portfolio, including production and portfolio targets measured through units sold, Annual Premium Equivalent (APE), Gross Written Premium (GWP) and other relevant business performance indicators.

You will help define where the business goes next while ensuring outstanding execution of today's portfolio.

You'll **report directly to Tribe Lead** and work alongside senior stakeholders across Business, Technology, Operations, Risk, Finance and Marketing.

**What you'll be doing**

**Drive the insurance business strategy**

* Define and execute the strategic roadmap for ING's core insurance portfolio.

* Identify growth opportunities across Home, Life and PPI products.

* Identify future protection opportunities and define ING's long-term insurance growth agenda.

* Translate market trends, customer needs and business priorities into actionable initiatives.

* Build and maintain business cases for new propositions, partnerships and investments.

* Define commercial ambitions and portfolio targets across sales, APE, GWP and profitability metrics.

**Grow and evolve our insurance portfolio**

* Lead the evolution of existing products to improve commercial performance, customer value and competitiveness.

* Identify gaps in the portfolio and define future protection propositions.

* Design customer-centric value propositions for new insurance products and services.

* Explore new business models, distribution opportunities and value-added services.

* Drive product profitability and sustainable growth.

* Lead the end-to-end setup and launch of new insurance products.

**Build and manage strategic partnerships**

* Lead relationships with insurance partners and providers.

* Act as ING's senior representative towards insurance companies and key external stakeholders.

* Build strong relationships with ING Headquarters and international insurance stakeholders.

* Ensure partnerships create long-term value for customers and ING.

* Challenge existing agreements and explore new market opportunities.

* Lead partner selection processes, RfPs, negotiations and commercial agreements.

**Accelerate commercial growth**

* Define actions to improve acquisition, conversion, retention and customer lifetime value.

* Unlock growth opportunities through segmentation, cross-sell, upsell and bundled propositions.

* Coordinate multiple commercial levers to maximize business performance.

* Own portfolio growth plans and commercial performance targets.

* Work closely with Marketing, Analytics and Customer Journey teams to optimize customer outcomes.

**Lead business transformation**

* Drive end-to-end initiatives from idea to implementation.

* Coordinate cross-functional teams to turn strategic opportunities into tangible results.

* Remove obstacles, align stakeholders and secure execution.

* Help shape the future operating model of the insurance business.

* Lead the implementation of new partnerships, products and capabilities.

**Lead and develop talent**

* Lead, coach and inspire a team of business strategy professionals.

* Build talent, develop future leaders and foster a high-performance culture.

* Create an environment of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning and innovation.

* Ensure alignment between team objectives and business outcomes.

**Be the voice of the customer and the business**

* Continuously understand customer needs, behaviors and expectations.

* Use data, customer insights and market intelligence to make informed decisions.

* Balance commercial objectives with customer value and long-term sustainability.

* Act as a role model for customer-centric thinking.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for someone who brings together business vision, execution power and the ability to make things happen in complex environments, with strong leadership capabilities to inspire teams, develop talent and help people grow beyond their own expectations.

**You have**

* At least 5 years of proven experience in the insurance industry, covering both Life and Non-Life products.

* Strong knowledge of insurance products, distribution models, partnerships and commercial dynamics.

* Experience defining and executing growth and business development strategies.

* Experience managing insurance providers, strategic partnerships and commercial negotiations.

* Experience leading Request for Proposal (RfP) processes and insurer selection projects.

* Experience leading high-performing teams and developing talent.

* Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives.

* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including senior executive interactions.

* Strong commercial and business development capabilities.

* Strong analytical and strategic thinking.

* Experience working in agile and multidisciplinary environments.

* Fluent English.

**You are**

* Entrepreneurial and ambitious.

* Customer obsessed.

* Data driven.

* Curious and innovative.

* Passionate about transforming the insurance industry.

* Comfortable challenging the status quo.

* A natural connector across teams, disciplines and organizations.

* A strong negotiator and relationship builder.

* An inspiring leader who develops people and teams.

* Able to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

* Passionate about creating new business opportunities.

* Resilient and able to navigate ambiguity.

**What do we offer?**

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

  

Check out what is waiting for you!

**Balance That Works.**

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

**Meal allowance.**

Receive your meal allowance in the way that best suits you: through a meal card or directly in your payroll, giving you greater flexibility and convenience in managing your everyday needs.

**More than an office.**

In our offices you can find doctor’s office, hairdresser, gym, Employee Concierge (to help you with your errands) and much more!

**Health and life insurance.**

We help you protect what matters most to you, including you and your immediate family.

**Flexible remuneration.**

Enjoy access to services such as nursery vouchers, public transport and training support, as well as other benefits through our flexible remuneration model.

**Commuting made easier.**

Our free shuttle service connects different areas of Madrid with ING MAD, helping make your commute to the office more comfortable and convenient.

**Banking benefits.**

Loans with preferential banking conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!

**More vitality and more belonging**

Our 360º wellbeing approach supports employees across Financial, Physical, Mental and Social Wellbeing.

On-site physiotherapy service.

A strong wellbeing culture, including Wellhub access, sports communities and activities.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

**Get to know Us**

We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: **doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves**, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.

A **fully online bank** where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with **agile methodologies**.

And although we are based in Spain, we **are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.**

We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of **Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging** to foster a culture of **collaboration and innovation** that represents all collectives in the society.

And even though we look orange on the outside, **we are green on the inside**. Our ambition in Sustainability is **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.

**Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA.** If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!

*At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.*

**Job Application Safety Reminder**

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

* **Apply only via official ING platforms:** ING uses **Workday** and **LinkedIn** as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted **only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn**.
* **Check the sender’s email carefully:** Legitimate communication will always come from **@ing.com** and/or **@myworkday.com**.
* **No payments or banking details will ever be requested:** If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

**En ING buscamos un/a Business Lead Insurance**

**Tu función y entorno de trabajo**

Buscamos a una persona con talento y entusiasmo para incorporarse como **Business Lead en nuestra Insurance Tribe**.

La Insurance Tribe tiene una misión clara: **convertir a ING en el lugar de referencia para las necesidades de protección de nuestra clientela**. Estamos construyendo una forma diferente de hacer seguros, creando propuestas simples, transparentes y verdaderamente valiosas para nuestras personas clientes, al tiempo que contribuimos al crecimiento sostenible de ING y distribuyéndolas a través de experiencias digitales de primer nivel.

Como Business Lead Insurance, serás responsable de definir, impulsar el crecimiento y transformar nuestro negocio principal de seguros, incluyendo seguros de Hogar, Vida y Protección de Pagos (PPI).

Además de gestionar y optimizar la cartera actual, desempeñarás un papel clave en la definición de la futura estrategia de negocio de seguros de ING España. Se espera que combines visión estratégica con una ejecución impecable, ayudando a ING a evolucionar continuamente su oferta de protección, al tiempo que generas crecimiento sostenible y valor para la clientela.

  

Serás responsable tanto del **rendimiento actual como de la agenda de crecimiento futura**, equilibrando la gestión de la cartera con el desarrollo de la próxima generación de propuestas de seguros para la clientela de ING.

Este no es un puesto tradicional dentro del sector asegurador. Combinarás estrategia, desarrollo comercial, gestión de partnerships, innovación de producto y ejecución. **Trabajarás en toda la cadena de valor**, conectando a clientes, aseguradoras, canales de distribución y equipos de analítica, operaciones y tecnología para acelerar el crecimiento y construir la próxima generación de propuestas de protección.

Actuarás como la **persona representante senior de tus productos** tanto dentro de la organización como externamente, gestionando las relaciones con partners aseguradores, ING Headquarters y stakeholders senior de toda la entidad. Se espera que influyas en la toma de decisiones, alinees múltiples intereses y construyas alianzas sólidas que aceleren el crecimiento del negocio.

Además, **liderarás y desarrollarás un equipo de profesionales de estrategia de negocio**, creando un entorno en el que el talento pueda desarrollarse, fomentando la responsabilidad, la colaboración y el alto rendimiento, y asegurando que el equipo contribuya de manera efectiva a los objetivos estratégicos de la Tribe.

También serás responsable de definir y **alcanzar los objetivos comerciales** de la cartera de seguros, incluyendo objetivos de producción y cartera medidos a través de unidades vendidas, Annual Premium Equivalent (APE), Gross Written Premium (GWP) y otros indicadores relevantes del rendimiento del negocio.

Ayudarás a definir el futuro del negocio mientras garantizas una ejecución excelente de la cartera actual.

**Reportarás directamente a la persona Tribe Lead** y trabajarás junto a stakeholders senior de las áreas de Business, Tecnología, Operaciones, Riesgos, Finanzas y Marketing.

**¿Qué harás?**

**Impulsar la estrategia del negocio de seguros**

* Definir y ejecutar la hoja de ruta estratégica de la cartera principal de seguros de ING.
* Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento en productos de Hogar, Vida y PPI.
* Identificar futuras oportunidades de protección y definir la agenda de crecimiento a largo plazo del negocio de seguros de ING.
* Transformar las tendencias del mercado, las necesidades de la clientela y las prioridades de negocio en iniciativas accionables.
* Elaborar y mantener business cases para nuevas propuestas, partnerships e inversiones.
* Definir ambiciones comerciales y objetivos de cartera en ventas, APE, GWP y métricas de rentabilidad.

**Hacer crecer y evolucionar nuestra cartera de seguros**

* Liderar la evolución de los productos existentes para mejorar el rendimiento comercial, el valor para la clientela y la competitividad.
* Identificar carencias en la cartera y definir futuras propuestas de protección.

* Actuar como representante senior de ING ante compañías aseguradoras y stakeholders externos clave.
* Construir relaciones sólidas con ING Headquarters y stakeholders internacionales del ámbito asegurador.
* Garantizar que los partnerships generen valor a largo plazo para la clientela y para ING.
* Cuestionar acuerdos existentes y explorar nuevas oportunidades de mercado.
* Liderar procesos de selección de partners, RfP, negociaciones y acuerdos comerciales.

**Acelerar el crecimiento comercial**

* Definir acciones para mejorar la captación, conversión, retención y customer lifetime value.
* Impulsar oportunidades de crecimiento mediante segmentación, cross-sell, upsell y propuestas combinadas.
* Coordinar múltiples palancas comerciales para maximizar el rendimiento del negocio.
* Liderar los planes de crecimiento de la cartera y los objetivos de rendimiento comercial.
* Trabajar estrechamente con los equipos de Marketing, Analytics y Customer Journey para optimizar los resultados para la clientela.

**Liderar la transformación del negocio**

* Impulsar iniciativas end-to-end desde la idea hasta la implementación.
* Coordinar equipos multifuncionales para convertir oportunidades estratégicas en resultados tangibles.
* Eliminar obstáculos, alinear stakeholders y garantizar la ejecución.
* Ayudar a definir el futuro modelo operativo del negocio asegurador.
* Liderar la implantación de nuevos partnerships, productos y capacidades.

**Liderar y desarrollar el talento**

* Desarrollar el talento, impulsar futuras personas líderes y fomentar una cultura de alto rendimiento.
* Crear un entorno de responsabilidad, colaboración, aprendizaje continuo e innovación.

**Ser la voz de la clientela y del negocio**

title: Senior Solutions Architect, EMEA
description:
Senior Solutions Architect, EMEA
================================

**Location:** Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC-1 to UTC+3)

**Clients:** Global. Primarily EMEA and North American.

**Reports to:** VP of Solutions

**Salary Range:** $70,000 - $150,000 USD annually. Compensation dependent on candidate experience and location.

About McGaw

**Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.**

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform & execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.

Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission
-------

Own technical delivery across your accounts. Design the stack, build the hard parts, direct the technical team, and keep projects on schedule and profitable.

Why this role exists
--------------------

Our clients are spread across North America and Europe, but our technical bench is not. European accounts wait a day for answers and North American accounts compete for the same people. This role adds senior technical capacity in a time zone that covers both.

  

Responsibilities
----------------

**Architecture and design**

* Design end-to-end customer data stacks: CDP, analytics, marketing automation, CRM, warehouse, pipelines, tag management, testing.
* Lead taxonomy design. Define events, properties, and naming before implementation, not after.
* Solve identity resolution across web, app, offline, and CRM.
* Write ecosystem docs that show where data moves and what breaks if it stops.

**Hands-on build**

* Build. This is not an advisory seat: you will be in the CDP, the warehouse, GTM, and the code.
* Write and review tracking, server-side integrations, and reverse ETL pipelines.
* Run QA to our two-person standard. Check every property in both the CDP and the destination, with a recorded walkthrough.

**Directing the team**

* Turn client requirements into scoped, sequenced tasks for engineers and contract developers.
* Review their work before it reaches a client. You are the quality gate.
* Unblock people. When a build stalls, you get it moving.

**Keeping delivery on track**

* Run the cadence: two-week sprints, a groomed backlog, and a roadmap with three or more months of planned work.
* Flag budget pacing early. Never surprise a client on budget.
* There are no free scope changes. Every change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.

**New business**

* Write technical specs for new opportunities. What gets built, in what order, and what it depends on.
* Produce level of effort estimates accurate enough that Sales can price without a rebuild.
* Join pre-sales calls when a prospect needs a technical answer in the room.
* Say when a prospect is not ready, and what would make them ready.

Skills and experience
---------------------

**Required**

* Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
* 6+ years designing and integrating marketing and customer data technology. At least 3 in an agency, consultancy, or professional services with multiple clients.
* Understand how CDPs drive marketing, with working knowledge of Segment, Hightouch, or RudderStack. No preference among them. Know one and you can learn the others.
* Proficient in JavaScript and SQL. Comfortable in a shared repo.
* Designed at least three full stacks, not just operated tools someone else picked.
* GDPR and consent handled as part of the build.

**Systems**

Depth in at least three groups, working familiarity with the rest:

* Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
* Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
* Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
* Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
* Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
* CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
* Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

**Preferred**

* Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
* Server-side tracking under EU consent rules.
* Work across both European and North American clients.

What you get out of this
------------------------

* Many stacks in a year instead of one stack in five. Different industries, scale, and failure modes.
* The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You build on the new pattern.
* We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. You see how it all fits together, which is where the hard problems are visible.
* Both European and North American markets from one seat.

Observable indicators
---------------------

**Month 2**

* Onboarded to every tool in your accounts' stacks.
* Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
* QA to the two-person standard on 100% of what you ship.

**Month 4**

* Running technical delivery on two or more accounts independently.
* Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
* Zero undocumented scope changes.

**Month 6**

* Labor efficiency ratio of 2.5 or better across your projects.
* 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
* Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
* New business specs and estimates accepted by Sales without rework 80% of the time.

**Month 9**

* Leading technical discovery without US support on the call.
* One expansion opportunity per quarter, surfaced with an estimate attached.

What this role is not
---------------------

* Not account leadership. You will not own the relationship, the renewal, or the P&L.
* Not a sales seat. You write specs and estimates and are paid a bonus on the result. You do not prospect.
* Not people management. You direct technical work. No direct reports at hiring stage.
* Not advisory. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong role.

Values
------

* Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
* Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
* Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your project is surprised by what you already knew.
* Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
* Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own outcomes, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits
--------

* Flexible PTO
* Flexible hours
* Work remotely
* Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
* Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
* Federal holidays off for US citizens, national holidays off for international contractors
* Radically transparent workplace
* Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice
-------------------

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

**Month 1.** Learn our clients, cadence, and tooling. Shadow live accounts. Run QA on other people's work to see our standard from the inside. Start owning tasks on one account.

**Months 2 and 3.** Take technical ownership of your first accounts. Build the roadmaps. Run the sprints. You still have support on client calls.

**Months 4 to 6.** Run delivery independently across accounts. Direct the resources assigned to you. Start writing specs for new business.

**After 6 months.** You are a technical authority across the portfolio. You lead discovery, scope new work, and set the standard new hires learn from.

**What is hard?** Accounts run at the same time and the work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. A portfolio across two continents splits your day in half. You will sometimes be the only person awake when a pipeline breaks.

title: Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Copy & Content
description:
**About Darkroom**
==================

**Darkroom** is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only - supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================

We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.

You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.

This is a copy-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================

You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt-in copy, welcome series, first-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
**Nebius Academy** (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for an **Application Security Engineer** to own product security end to end — from threat modelling and secure design reviews to vulnerability management and security controls embedded into CI/CD.

You will work closely with product and platform teams to make security part of the engineering process, building secure defaults and helping prevent vulnerabilities from reaching production without slowing development down.

  
Requirements:
  

* 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on Application Security or Product Security.
* Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.
* Deep practical knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, authentication and session management, OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML, and authorization issues such as IDOR and broken access control.
* Experience securing multitenant or B2B SaaS products, including tenant isolation, RBAC / ABAC, and access control models.
* Hands-on experience embedding security into CI/CD, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and IaC scanning.
* Strong experience with threat modelling, secure design reviews, and secure code reviews in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
* Experience managing vulnerabilities based on risk, criticality, and exploitability, including remediation prioritisation and escalation when needed.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes security, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and auditors.
* Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or above.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience building a DevSecOps practice from scratch.
* Experience running or participating in a Security Champions programme.
* Hands-on penetration testing experience.
* Experience securing LLM-powered or AI products.
* Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective.
* Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

  
Brand:
  
Nebius Academy  
  
What you will do:
  

* Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow-up.
* Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
* Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
* Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.
* Drive vulnerability management across application code and cloud posture, including triage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation timelines, and external pentest findings.
* Strengthen security in multitenant B2B systems, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, RBAC / ABAC, and access controls.
* Work on cloud and Kubernetes security across AWS environments, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
* Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
* Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day-to-day work.

* A supportive and proactive work environment.
* Competitive compensation: 4000-6000 EUR Gross per month
* Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
* Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
* Tangible results measured by student success.

**Company Description**

**Talan – Positive Innovation**

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

**Talan at a Glance**

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

**Our Core Areas of Expertise**

* **Data & Technologies:** We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.
* **Cloud & Application Services:** We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.
* **Management & Innovation Consulting:** We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

**We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.**

 **Job Description**

We’re looking for a **Senior Cybersecurity** to join a global Cybersecurity Operations team responsible for protecting critical environments and supporting international organizations against evolving cyber threats.

You’ll be part of a **24x7 Security Operations Centre (SOC)**, working with cybersecurity specialists across the world to monitor, investigate and respond to security incidents. This is a hands-on role where your technical expertise will directly contribute to improving threat detection, incident response and overall security.

What will you do?

* Monitor, triage and investigate security alerts across **SIEM, EDR, Microsoft Security and cloud environments**.
* Investigate potential cyber threats and security incidents, identifying **root causes and appropriate remediation actions**.
* Analyze logs from **Windows, Linux, databases, applications, web servers, firewalls and network security systems**.
* Work closely with Incident Response teams and cybersecurity specialists to contain and resolve threats.
* Use and maintain security monitoring and detection tools, helping improve detection quality and reduce false positives.
* Prepare clear **security reports, incident summaries and technical findings** for clients.
* Manage security-related tickets and ensure incidents are properly documented.
* Contribute to improving SOC processes, procedures, documentation and knowledge bases.
* Work directly with clients to understand their environments and optimize security monitoring.
* Stay up to date with emerging threats, technologies and cybersecurity best practices.

  
**Qualifications**

️ What are we looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical skills with a proactive and collaborative mindset.

**You should have:**

* **5+ years of experience** in IT, Cybersecurity or Security Operations.
* Hands-on experience working in a **SOC environment**, including security alert triage and incident investigation.
* Strong knowledge of **SIEM and EDR technologies**.
* Experience with platforms such as **Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight or ELK**.
* Experience with **Microsoft Security technologies**, including Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft 365, Sentinel, Azure Security and XDR.
* Strong understanding of **Azure, AWS and/or GCP**.
* Experience with at least one EDR solution, such as **Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or CrowdStrike**.
* Strong knowledge of **networking and TCP/IP**.
* Excellent experience analyzing security logs across **Windows and Linux environments**.
* Knowledge of **email security, network monitoring and incident response**.
* Experience managing and processing **security tickets**.
* Excellent **spoken and written English**.
* It would be a plus if you have:

* Experience working in an **Incident Response team**, particularly Tier I/II.
* Experience monitoring **AWS environments**, including IaaS, PaaS and SaaS.
* Scripting experience with **Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ruby or similar**.
* Cybersecurity certifications such as **SC-200, GCIH, CEH, GCFA, GIAC, CCNA or MCSE**.
* Experience working in a **global, distributed SOC**.

  
**Additional Information**

**What do we offer you?**

* Full-time and permanent employment contract or contractor mode
* Remote location in Spain or any other European country.
* Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities
* Possibility to join a multicultural team & work in the international environment
* Variety of benefits to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing: private medical insurance, life insurance, lunch and transport card as part of the flexible remuneration pack, and online language classes

title: Human-AI Interaction Researcher
description:
**Company Description**

Meet Unit4. With over 40 years of heritage, we’re an agile, fast growing, Cloud company that is on a mission to redefine Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for mid-market people-centric organisations.

With our innovative, self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high-value work.

At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose: **Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters.** — A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.

We’re shaping **how work should feel**, and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need - it's what makes us unique.

 **Job Description**

*A research position in Unit4 CTO, joining the team in Labs. You will work on how people and AI agents work together, so the systems agents operate stay understandable, trustworthy, and useful to the people they serve.*

**About the role**

Enterprise software has always been an information system. For most of its history it was an information system built for people to operate directly. People read the screens, entered the data, and moved work through the steps the system laid out. The data meant something and the process meant something, but that meaning lived in the heads of the people using the system and in the code underneath it, never in a form the system itself could reason about.

That is changing now that meaning can be made explicit, so the system represents it, something else can read and act on it, and that something is increasingly an agent. The information system is becoming one that agents operate, in service of the people it has always been for. As the burden of reading the system, traversing it, and acting through it moves onto the software, the person's part changes. They author intent and judge outcomes rather than traverse machinery. How that relationship should work, how an agent should communicate, how it earns and keeps trust, and what it does to the way people think, decide, and work, are open questions. This role works on exactly that.

**What already exists**

Our AI First program has built a layered architecture in which meaning sits between the raw data and the agents that reason over it, a semantic data model and a semantic business process model, with metadata pipelines, data contracts, a catalog, and an ontology graph delivered as a proven proof of concept and now moving toward delivery. Agents already answer business questions over this layer. What we do not yet have is a research line on the human side of that interaction. Human-AI interaction is a new research area in Unit4 Research, and you would help define it from the start, drawing on what the program has built and on the experience of the teams taking agents into product. This is research on the relationship between people and AI, rather than product usability or customer research, though it should inform both.

**What you will work on**

This is a research role, so the questions are open, but the starting problems are concrete.

* Define and run the research agenda for human-AI interaction at Unit4, setting its priorities together with the program.
* Study how AI should interact and communicate with users, including how an agent presents itself, explains what it did, and signals what it is unsure of.
* Understand how trust between people and agents is built, calibrated, and lost, so people rely on an agent when they should and question it when they should not.
* Examine the cognitive and behavioral impact of AI on productivity and decision-making in everyday enterprise work.
* Help make human-AI collaboration safe, fair, transparent, and trustworthy, working with our responsible AI stakeholders.
* Turn findings into principles and patterns that guide future AI experiences across Unit4.
* Build links with universities and academic institutions, and help decide whether research collaborations or interns would add value and which profiles we need.

**How the work is shared**

You would open this research area within Unit4 Research, providing subject-matter guidance without formally managing a team. You work alongside the architecture and AI research people on the meaning layer, including the information scientists working on how meaning is represented and evaluated, where questions about how people and agents find and interpret meaning meet. You also work with the product, design, and engineering teams taking agents into delivery, and with responsible AI stakeholders.

**What we offer**

* The chance to shape a new research area from its start, inside an established program whose work is already proven and now scaling.
* A place in Unit4 Research, close to our architecture and AI research people and to the teams taking agents into product.
* A research mandate judged by whether the findings change how we design and build AI experiences across Unit4.
* Room to build links with academia and to help shape how Unit4 collaborates with universities in this area.
* An international and multidisciplinary environment, working in English.

  
**Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

You might currently hold a title like human-computer interaction researcher, cognitive scientist, human factors researcher, behavioral scientist, UX researcher with a strong research focus, or have a keen interest in the topic. The label matters less than the way you think about how people and intelligent systems work together and some real experience studying it.

What we hope you bring.

* Some experience researching how people think, decide, or work with technology, from cognitive science, human-computer interaction, human factors, psychology, or a related field.
* A solid command of research methods, qualitative and quantitative, from designing studies and experiments to drawing sound conclusions from them.
* The ability to own a research area, framing the right questions, setting priorities, and moving forward with limited guidance.
* The ability to turn academic findings into practical principles and recommendations that product and engineering teams can act on, and to explain them to people who do not share your background.
* The habit of asking what a person is actually trying to achieve, and what they need to understand, before asking how the system should respond.

What you can pick up after joining.

* The ERPx domain and the specifics of our architecture. We do not expect you to arrive knowing enterprise resource planning.
* The particulars of how large language models and agents work, if you have the depth on the human side but less exposure to the model side.

We are glad to invest in people who want to grow into this. If you have the research depth and the interest but less exposure to AI or enterprise software, we will sponsor the learning.

**Helpful, but not required**

* Research on trust, explainability, or human oversight of automated or AI systems.
* Experience studying knowledge work or decision-making in organizational settings.
* Experience with academic collaboration, publishing, or building university partnerships.
* Familiarity with responsible AI principles or AI regulation.

  
**Additional Information**

**Who we are?**

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.

We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated. We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

**What we offer**

* a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
* balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
* growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
* talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
* a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
* a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

**Our commitment to equity**

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

* Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
* Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

No worries though – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your info safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!*

### **Goodwall**

Goodwall is a TIME100 award-winning social education app that believes learning should be as fun and easy as scrolling on TikTok. Goodwall exists to give every young person the opportunity to pursue a better future, regardless of where they come from or who they know. Our free social education app helps more than 4 million members develop skills, gain confidence and access opportunities that can transform their lives.

Goodwall is free for young people. Our programs are funded by Fortune 500 corporates, government and nonprofit partners, including Microsoft, HP, and the United Nations. The growth we create has to show up in real skills and opportunities, not just downloads, so we use everything in our arsenal, from game design to behavioural psychology, to create the most engaging learning experiences for the next generation.

As a B Corp scale-up backed by leading investors, Goodwall has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, TIME100 Top EdTech, and featured by FastCompany, Bloomberg, CNBC and Forbes. Our next chapter is to transform the lives of 10 million Goodwallers.

### **Your Role**

You will lead Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with our Co-Founder. You will lead and grow your own team, including an additional Product Manager and Growth Marketing Manager. Your closest partner will be our Head of Engineering, who also leads Data Science.

Your responsibility spans how members discover Goodwall, experience its value, keep coming back and bring their friends. You will set direction and stay close to execution. Every product experience, notification, piece of ad copy, ambassador referral journey and Gen Z creator strategy sits within your remit.

### **What you will do**

* **Scale a product members love returning to.** Own the product roadmap and run product growth experiments that improve activation, retention and referrals. Use onboarding, personalisation, social features, rewards and game design to make learning more engaging.
* **Accelerate member acquisition.** Expand organic growth through ambassadors, referrals, creators and influencers, supported by disciplined paid marketing. Lead our expansion into target markets such as North America.
* **Bring Product and Growth together.** Align both teams around shared priorities. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to turn member insights into improvements, from idea through launch and measurement.
* **Set the standard for every detail.** Take responsibility for the quality of the entire member experience, from the clarity of a notification and the simplicity of a product flow to the strength of an ad hook. Combine sharp copy, thoughtful design and precise execution.
* **Experiment with purpose.** Speak with members, understand where they lose interest and test ways to keep them engaged. Run A/B tests, assess retention over time and use the findings to decide what to scale, improve or stop.
* **Hire and lead a strong team.** Choose priorities, develop your people and direct budget toward lasting growth. Move quickly, remove obstacles and take responsibility for results.

* **Competitive** **compensation** and **equity**: an ownership stake in a scale up raising its Series B.
* Real **authority** across Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with the founders.
* The opportunity to hire and lead **your** **own** **team**.
* An **established** **global** **community** and the chance to shape the experience of millions more members.
* And most importantly, a **mission to be proud** **of** - helping millions of young people build skills, access opportunity and shape their futures

### **What You Bring**

* **You know how to scale.** You have personally helped scale a digital product serving millions, ideally where what worked early stopped working and needed new methods. You can explain what you owned, what you changed, and the results.
* **Depth in product growth.** You have shipped experiments that improved retention and referrals alongside acquisition. Experience in Social, Gaming or EdTech is particularly relevant.
* **Ownership and urgency.** You take ownership of the outcome, move with urgency and follow through with intensity. You find ways forward with limited resources and stay close enough to the work to solve problems yourself.
* **Instinctive Gen Z fluency.** You live and breathe the platforms, creators, communities and formats shaping how Gen Z communicates. You know what earns attention, what gets shared and what feels forced.
* **Exceptional attention to detail.** You recognise strong design and sharp copy, and notice the friction others miss. You care about the small decisions that make an experience feel effortless.
* **Analytical and creative judgment.** You can interpret a retention curve, improve a creator brief and work through a product decision with engineers.
* **Commitment to the mission.** You want to use your expertise to transform lives. Helping millions of young people gain skills, confidence and access to opportunity is work you are ready to invest yourself in.

**Job ID** R-260918 **Date posted** 09/30/2026

The Global Development Scientist in Clinical Development and AI will provide scientific and clinical input to all aspects of late-stage product development and AI-assisted ways of working. This includes but is not limited to the design, delivery, and interpretation of pivotal clinical trials and of studies that further characterize the overall benefit and risk and value of products in respiratory and immunology therapeutic area (TA) in late-stage development. In this role the scientist will seek input from the appropriate functional experts and will coordinate these activities in support of clinical studies and programs.

The Global Development Scientist in Clinical Development and AI will work to ensure that the safety evaluation process for phase II/III trials is seamless and complete, and develop and deploy AI solutions to assist this aim.

The objectives of the Global Development Scientist will be set by the Global Clinical Program Lead (GCPL) in agreement with Global Clinical Head (GCH).

The role will have a special focus on late-stage clinical trials within the Respiratory TA where the Global Development Scientist will work in close collaboration with the study team physician, sites, and other cross-function stakeholders in Respiratory and the wider AI community with all aspects of scientific input, clinical data quality metrics and safety evaluation.

Alongside delivery of the role’s established scientific and clinical responsibilities, the Global Development Scientist will act as a lead for selected AI-enabled use cases—identifying high-value opportunities, translating clinical needs into clear requirements, piloting solutions in live studies, piloting and evaluating workflows, and supporting adoption at scale.

A key purpose of the role is to support the deployment of AI-assisted methods that maintain/enhance quality whilst accelerating the design, conduct, data review and interpretation; ensuring the retention of accountable human scientific and clinical judgement and analysis of clinical trials. Always ensuring that the novel AI solutions deployed follow appropriate governance processes and maintain the standards of Good Clinical Practice (GCP). All of this with the ultimate goal of helping to bring new treatments to patients.

The role will connect clinical domain expertise with AI capabilities. It will help establish reusable approaches rather than isolated pilots, with success assessed through evidence of adoption and measurable improvements in clinical development outcomes, quality, efficiency or cycle time.

You will be expected to collaborate effectively with colleagues in late-stage Respiratory groups, and to build productive connections. You will combine strong scientific judgement with curiosity about emerging AI methods, communicate benefits and limitations clearly, and support colleagues to use approved tools confidently and responsibly. You will present scientific and AI-enabled insights to multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders and contribute as a member of a diverse, motivated team spanning multiple divisions of Biopharmaceuticals R&D.

* Provide scientific leadership in the innovative design, execution and interpretation of clinical trials in one or more development programs.

* Effectively collaborate with colleagues in other functions including Patient Safety, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, and early development groups.

* Be involved primarily in late stage (PhIIb and Phase III) clinical programs and to collaborate with clinical colleagues supporting early-stage programs as well as medical affairs colleagues.

* Provide expert scientific input into the preparation of regulatory documents and interactions with regulatory authorities.

* Provide expert scientific review, analysis, and interpretation of data from ongoing studies and in the literature.

* Lead development of quality metrics and data review plan for assigned studies.

* Identify and prioritise clinical development activities where AI assistance can add meaningful value, define the clinical problem and intended outcome, and agree fit-for-purpose success measures with study and functional partners, including stakeholder alignment, workflow integration, user feedback, training, adoption monitoring and transition from pilot to sustained use

* Support and contribute to medical monitoring of trials.

* Lead and participate in activities that ensure quality, consistency and integration of clinical study related deliverables and ensure safety evaluation process within the clinical team.

* Provide clinical leadership for the testing and validation of AI-assisted outputs, ensuring appropriate human review, traceability, data quality, privacy, security and compliance with applicable quality and regulatory expectations, embedding fit-for-purpose methods into study and programme workflows

* Ensure scientific input to TA standards.

* Provide scientific evidence to support strategic decision making for R&D, marketing, clinical, and business development departments.

* Present protocol and scientific results to multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders

* Develop and review protocols, informed consent, investigator’s brochure and other clinical development documents.

* Organize and analyse data from clinical research to build new hypothesis.

* Support upskilling in AI-assisted ways of working and contribute to the development of AI capability across Respiratory Clinical Development and engage with AI user networks and relevant cross-functional initiatives to share learning, promote reuse and scale effective AI-assisted practices.

**Education, Qualifications, Skills, and Experience**

* Relevant university degree with extensive experience from clinical development.

* Three or more years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience (multi-country clinical trials) is required.

* Understanding of scientific and clinical issues related to the design and implementation of clinical trials and interpreting trial results particularly in respiratory and immunology clinical development.

* Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional setting.

* Experience particularly in Phase II and Phase III clinical development.

* Experience using AI technologies and building or deploying AI solutions in a work environment, with demonstrated competence applying AI in clinical, biomedical or drug development settings

 **Job Description**

El Ranchito is looking for a Machine Learning Artist / Technical Director who combines strong visual judgement with coding and applied machine-learning skills.

Reporting to the Machine Learning Supervisor, this is a hands-on, production-facing role focused on using ML to solve real VFX challenges. The position sits between artistry, pipeline development and applied machine learning: understanding how high-quality visual effects are created while having the technical ability to build, adapt and troubleshoot the tools behind them.

This is not a role focused solely on generating images with existing tools. We are looking for someone who can understand a production problem, investigate possible technical solutions, build or adapt a workflow, evaluate its limitations and help artists use it successfully on real work.

Candidates may come from any VFX department—including compositing, FX or Lighting. Professional experience as a production VFX artist or artist-facing TD is strongly preferred.

Exceptional ML candidates without a traditional VFX background may also be considered if they demonstrate outstanding technical depth, strong visual judgement and highly relevant work in image, video, 3D or other areas directly applicable to VFX production.

The role is open to candidates based in Spain.

 **Qualifications**  

* Professional production experience as a VFX artist or artist-facing TD in at least one department is strongly preferred.
* A strong reel, portfolio or body of work demonstrating visual judgement and technical problem-solving.
* Practical experience applying machine learning, computer vision or generative models to image, video, geometry or related media.
* Strong Python skills and experience creating maintainable production tools.
* Familiarity with Git, APIs, package and environment management, and reproducible development practices.
* Experience with an ML framework such as PyTorch or equivalent.
* A working understanding of model inference, datasets, evaluation, fine-tuning and GPU-based processing.
