**Company Overview**
====================

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

**Company Operating Rhythm**
============================

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Deepgram is looking for a **Security Engineer** to build and automate the technical controls behind our security program. Most of our infrastructure is bare metal in colocation datacenters — GPU-intensive, running containerized workloads on Docker, managed with Ansible, and shipped through CI/CD on GitHub Actions — with AWS used for overflow capacity and a small set of services. Our engineering culture is high-trust and fast-moving. That means controls have to be delivered as code, be reproducible, and produce their own audit evidence — anything that depends on someone remembering to do it manually will not survive.

You will own real surface area: host hardening and configuration management across the fleet, vulnerability and patch management, penetration testing, container security, detection and response, CI/CD and supply chain security, and the engineering work behind our SOC 2, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001 obligations. You will also be expected to use AI and agentic tooling aggressively to punch above your weight on a small team, and to help us secure the AI systems we build and the AI tools we adopt internally.

This is the hands-on technical seat. A GRC and Security Compliance Lead owns policy authorship, security questionnaires, and the auditor relationship; you own the controls themselves and the evidence they generate, and you give that role the technical answers it needs.

This role reports to the Director of Information Security.

*Note: as reflected on our published compensation ranges, we are open on level. Strong mid-level and senior candidates are both in scope, and we will calibrate title, scope, and compensation to demonstrated experience.*

**About Deepgram**
------------------

Deepgram builds foundational voice AI — speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent infrastructure — used by enterprises and developers to build production voice applications at scale. Our models are trained and served on our own infrastructure, and we offer hosted, dedicated single-tenant, and self-hosted deployment options so customers can meet their own data residency and retention requirements. Learn more at deepgram.com.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build, deploy, and maintain security controls across our bare-metal fleet and AWS footprint — access management, network segmentation and firewalling, encryption and secrets management, logging and detection coverage, endpoint security, and vulnerability management.
* Own configuration management and host hardening as code with Ansible, so baselines are reproducible across hundreds of Linux hosts and drift is detectable rather than merely documented.
* Secure containerized workloads: Docker image build pipelines, registry scanning, runtime hardening and detection, and secrets management.
* Run vulnerability management end to end — discovery, prioritization by real exploitability rather than raw CVSS, driving remediation with engineering teams, and reporting on it.
* Own patch and update management as a program: the server fleet, the endpoint fleet, base images, OS and package updates, firmware where it matters, and dependency upgrades. Set and hold patch SLAs, track exceptions, and automate the routine cases so they do not depend on anyone remembering.
* Own the penetration testing lifecycle: scoping and vendor selection, scheduling, triaging findings into engineering work with real owners and dates, verifying fixes on retest, and producing the summary we can share with customers.
* Write detections, tune out noise, and take part in incident response. Improve log, telemetry, and security-agent coverage where we are blind.
* Run periodic log and access reviews as a standing control, and automate the collection so each cycle produces its own evidence rather than a scramble.
* Automate compliance evidence collection for SOC 2, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001, and support audit fieldwork on technical questions — the GRC lead owns the auditor relationship and the narrative; you own the systems that make the evidence true and repeatable.
* Harden GitHub Actions CI/CD and the software supply chain: dependency and secret scanning, action pinning, SBOM, artifact and image signing, least-privilege OIDC in place of long-lived credentials.
* Apply AI and agentic tooling to security work — triage, evidence gathering, code review, detection engineering — and help secure how the rest of the company uses AI.
* Provide the technical input behind customer-facing security work: questionnaire and architecture answers, penetration test summaries, and hardening guidance for customers running Deepgram self-hosted.

**Skills Needed**
-----------------

* Solid experience in security engineering or infrastructure engineering with a security focus — enough that you have owned controls in production, not just recommended them.
* Deep Linux. You should be comfortable hardening, debugging, and reasoning about a large fleet of physical Linux hosts — users and sudo, SSH, systemd, kernel and package updates, host firewalls, and what a host-based agent is actually doing.
* Ansible at fleet scale is required. You automate first and document second.
* Strong scripting. Python and/or Go, plus real shell competence.
* Production experience securing Docker containers and the pipelines that build them.
* Hands-on experience securing GitHub and GitHub Actions: branch protection, CODEOWNERS, workflow permissions, secrets, and third-party action risk.
* Experience running vulnerability and patch management as an ongoing program — including the unglamorous part, which is getting other teams to actually ship the fix.
* Experience managing third-party penetration tests from the inside: scoping them well, and turning a report into closed engineering work rather than a PDF in a folder.
* Hands-on involvement in at least one formal audit — ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or SOC 2 — as the engineer producing and defending evidence, not only as a reader of the report.
* Comfortable using AI coding and agentic tools in daily work, and clear-eyed about their risks: prompt injection, secret leakage, and supply chain exposure.
* Pragmatic. Controls that block shipping without a proportionate risk reduction get routed around, and we would rather you name the trade-off than pretend it does not exist.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Datacenter or colocation experience: network segmentation, out-of-band management (IPMI/BMC), physical and vendor controls.
* Detection engineering or SIEM/HIDS ownership at scale (for example Wazuh, OSSEC, Elastic).
* Secrets management with HashiCorp Vault.
* AWS security (IAM, SCPs, VPC) and Terraform.
* Kubernetes security.
* Offensive security background: penetration testing or red teaming.
* PCI DSS work inside a cardholder data environment.
* Ownership of a secure SDLC program.
* Experience with GPU infrastructure, ML platforms, or multi-tenant inference workloads.
* Certifications such as OSCP, GIAC, CISSP, or AWS Security Specialty.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
**Senior Account Executive**
============================

Full-Time | Remote (U.S., preference for California) | Reports to Director of Sales

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

* Polimorphic is building the operating system for how the government serves its people. Deployed across 100+ government agencies nationwide, our AI platform is transforming how counties, cities, and state organizations deliver services to millions of residents. Polimorphic is backed by top investors including General Catalyst, M13, Shine, and Pear. Customer service in government is a top-three problem in the world, and we are positioned at the center of solving it.
* This is not another SaaS sale. When you close a deal here, you are genuinely changing lives: a family who can now navigate benefits in minutes instead of days, a veteran who finally gets connected to the right services, a small business owner who can pull a permit without taking a day off work. The impact is real, measurable, and immediate.
* We are looking for a Senior Account Executive who wants to build something extraordinary at a venture-backed company in hypergrowth. You will own a territory, build a pipeline from scratch, close meaningful deals, and have a direct hand in shaping how we go to market. This is ground-floor work with real upside.

**What This Role Is**
---------------------

This is not a quota-carrying seat where you run someone else’s playbook and wait for inbound leads. You are the tip of the spear in your territory. You will prospect, build relationships, construct compelling business cases, navigate complex buying processes, and close deals. You are selling a category of solution that your buyers have never seen before.

**In practice, this means:**

* You bring energy, urgency, and creative thinking to every deal. You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see the gap, build the plan, and move.
* You think from first principles. Government procurement has myths and assumptions baked in. You question what’s real, challenge what’s slow, and find faster paths to “yes.”
* You are as comfortable building a quantitative business case for a city manager as you are building rapport with a frontline department head. You can do both because you understand that great selling is part relationship, part logic, and part urgency.
* You don’t treat objections as dead ends. You treat them as information. You dig in, reframe, and find the angle that moves the deal forward.
* You operate with the intensity of someone building their own business. End-of-quarter urgency is not a performance, it’s how you work every day.
* You are a creative problem-solver. When the standard playbook doesn’t work, you invent a new one. You think about 10X bets, not just incremental improvements.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Own Your Territory**

* Develop and execute a strategic sales plan for your region. You own the number, the plan to hit it, and the pipeline to back it up.
* Prospect relentlessly into state and local government accounts through research, networking, outbound campaigns, and creative outreach. Warm leads are a bonus, not a crutch.
* Manage the full sales cycle from first conversation to a signed contract. You qualify hard, build urgency, and drive deals to close.
* Build a pipeline that is real and 4x coverage. You know every deal, its blockers, its timeline, and your next move. No happy ears, no fiction in the forecast.
* Maximize the investments the company is making in marketing, sales development, consultants, and engineering for your territory. These are resources, not safety nets.

### **Build Business Cases, Not Just Relationships**

* Understand your buyers’ world deeply: their budgets, their pain points, their political dynamics. You translate that understanding into compelling, quantitative cases for why Polimorphic is the answer.
* Deliver sharp product presentations and demonstrations tailored to each stakeholder. A one-size-fits-all demo is a wasted meeting.
* Sell the vision of a unified government services platform, not just individual product modules. Help the market understand what’s possible.
* Negotiate and close deals that drive profitable growth. You understand that a great deal is one where both sides feel the urgency to move forward.

### **Feed the Machine**

* Provide accurate, rigorous sales forecasts and pipeline reports. Radical transparency on where things stand.
* Funnel market intelligence back into the organization. In a company this size, an AE who hears the market clearly shapes the product roadmap, the marketing strategy, and the competitive positioning. That’s not optional; it’s a responsibility.
* Stay sharp on industry trends, competitor moves, and market shifts. Share what you learn across the team. Best practice creation and sharing is how we all get better.
* Collaborate with marketing on region-specific campaigns and represent Polimorphic at industry events, conferences, and trade shows.
* Contribute to building the playbook. We are creating the go-to-market motion in real-time. Your voice, your creativity, and your learnings from the field will directly shape how the company sells.

### **Sell What Hasn’t Been Sold Before**

* Be comfortable operating in ambiguity. We are bringing a platform product to a market that hasn’t seen it. You won’t have a finished playbook on day one; you will build it as you go and iterate based on what you learn.
* Challenge the myths and crutches that slow down government sales. Bring an outsider’s perspective to what can and should be done differently.
* Think like a business owner, not an order-taker. “We’re tracking to $X, but if we approached the Y market this way, I believe we can get to $Z. Here’s why and here’s what I need.”

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in software sales, with a proven and consistent track record of exceeding targets. We will ask for specifics: what was your quota, what did you close, and what was actually your doing versus inherited pipeline.
* Demonstrated success selling complex, consultative solutions with multi-stakeholder buying processes. Enterprise experience is strongly preferred. Agentic AI experience is a plus.
* A first-principles thinker who builds business cases, not just slide decks. You can construct a quantitative ROI argument as naturally as you can build personal rapport.
* Comfort prospecting and building pipelines from scratch. You are self-motivated, proactive, and do not require micromanagement to perform at a high level.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. You are credible in a boardroom and authentic one-on-one.
* Ability to travel throughout your region as needed (likely 20–30%).
* An entrepreneurial, creative, “can do” spirit. You are energized by building, not maintaining.

### **Strongly Preferred**

* Experience at a venture-backed, high-growth startup (Series A through C). You know what it feels like to sell in a resource-constrained, fast-moving environment where you have to build the plane while flying it.
* Experience selling platform or multi-product solutions, including land-and-expand and upsell motions.
* Private sector sales background with the hunger and intensity of someone who has carried a bag and built a book of business. Government sales experience is a bonus, not a requirement. We value the mindset significantly more than the Rolodex.
* Comfort operating across industries and pivoting into new verticals. You learn fast and adapt your approach based on what the market tells you.
* A genuine orientation toward impact. You are motivated by the idea that this work changes real lives, not just hits a number.

**Who Thrives Here**
--------------------

* You are a workhorse who leads from the front. You don’t wait to be asked. You see the gap and fill it, whether that’s rewriting a proposal at midnight, jumping on a call with a skeptical county administrator, or driving three hours to get face-time with a decision maker because that’s what the deal needs. You bring the same grit to closing a $50K pilot as you do to architecting a $500K enterprise deal.
* You are collaborative but not passive. You share what’s working, learn from what isn’t, and push the team to get better every week. Healthy competitiveness is great; building a winning playbook together is better.
* You are drawn to this role because you want to build something that matters. Government customer service is broken. Every day, millions of people struggle to access basic services because the systems designed to help them are outdated, confusing, and slow. Polimorphic is fixing that, and this role puts you on the front lines of how fast and how far we go.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary, commission structure, and equity in the company.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) plan.
* Unlimited vacation policy and standard holidays off.
* Professional development opportunities and a clear path to grow into leadership.

In this role, you will lead Model N’s corporate communications, public relations, and branding efforts. You will work closely with executive leadership, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Internal Communications to strengthen Model N’s market presence, elevate brand credibility, and amplify our position as a trusted leader in revenue optimization and compliance for life sciences.

This role is critical to ensuring our brand, messaging, and communications efforts are aligned and impactful. You’ll help shape how Model N is perceived by customers, prospects, partners, media, industry leaders, and employees.

* Partner closely with Internal Communications to develop complementary communications strategies for significant company milestones, like M&A, leadership announcements, and beyond.

* Oversee day-to-day agency management, including contracts, budgets, reporting, and renewals.

* Lead social media editorial planning, content development, campaign execution, and performance reporting across channels.

* Assess existing corporate communications, brand, social media, and executive communications programs and identify opportunities for improvement.

* Take ownership of agency relationships, ongoing communications initiatives, and brand governance activities.

* Become a trusted advisor to key stakeholders on communications, brand, and messaging strategy.

* Own corporate "About Us" content and narrative across web and external materials, ensuring alignment with brand and content strategy.

title: Director, Product
description:
The Director of Product is an experienced practitioner who leads delivery on complex product engagements for automotive OEM and Tier-1 clients, ensuring teams have the definition and clarity they need to execute. This role moves fluidly across strategic product management and the full product development lifecycle from discovery and scoping through execution, launch, and iteration- bringing a systems-minded perspective that makes product strategy concrete and buildable in a highly regulated, program-driven automotive environment.

They have command-level fluency with AI tools and applying them across research, competitive and market analysis, documentation, requirements analysis, and workflow management. Beyond delivering a project, this Director helps clients build AI-ready delivery capacity while operating as a trusted, embedded member of the client's product organization rather than an outside vendor.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Lead technical and product discovery on active automotive engagements, surfacing user needs, business requirements, platform constraints, and integration realities that shape scope and sequencing
* Conduct competitive and market analysis and user research specific to automotive/mobility experiences, and translate findings into clear, buildable requirements
* Develop and maintain client-facing product roadmaps, translating strategic goals into phased, feasible plans that reflect technical realities, OEM program timelines, and a coherent long-term vision
* Represent the auto product roadmap and team in org-wide meetings, acting as a core member of the client's product organization
* Own backlog prioritization and scope trade-off decisions, working with clients, partners, and engineering leads to make deliberate, impact-driven choices against critical internal and partner-facing timelines
* Define release criteria, quality benchmarks, and post-launch feedback mechanisms; use data from prior phases to inform requirements and improve delivery quality across iterations
* Own end-to-end product delivery, writing product documentation, user stories, and acceptance criteria to a level of detail engineering and design can build from directly
* Lead sprint ceremonies, manage cross-functional coordination, and keep engineering, design, research, and client/partner stakeholders aligned and moving day to day
* Serve as the primary product point of contact for external partners (OEM and Tier-1 counterparts)
* Support business development with product input
* Identify and implement process improvements, including AI-assisted workflows, that improve team throughput, and advise clients on adopting similar practices to build more autonomous delivery teams

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED**

* 8+ years of experience in product management roles, with a track record of owning complex engagements end-to-end
* Automotive product & interfaces background strongly preferred, including at least one automotive product taken to launch and working knowledge of how OEM and Tier-1 programs run
* Deep working knowledge of agile delivery methodologies and product artifacts — epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specs, and process documentation — written to a level of detail engineering and design can build from
* Fluency in CMSes, platform architecture, API documentation, and integration planning sufficient to partner credibly with engineering leads on scoping and trade-off decisions
* Experience with competitive/market analysis and user research, and the ability to translate both into clear requirements
* Strong client and partner communication skills: comfortable managing scope conversations, reporting delivery progress, acting as the main product contact for external partners, and navigating difficult trade-offs with senior stakeholders
* Command-level fluency with AI tools for research, prototyping, documentation, requirements analysis, and workflow, with informed judgment about where they improve throughput and where precision still requires human review
* Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to technical scoping in new business contexts; collaborative instinct across design, engineering, and research disciplines
* Self-starter who can hit the ground running on day one, operating as a core member of the product organization rather than an outside resource

**ABOUT US**

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We're always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

*The compensation range for this role is $170,000 – $200,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.*

title: Fractional Media Director (Part-Time)
description:
**ABOUT PHASE 3 MARKETING & COMMUNICATIONS:**  
  
Phase 3 Marketing and Communications is an integrated marketing services company providing solutions from ideation to execution. Our mission is to simplify life for marketers by delivering the most-needed marketing services in-house, under one roof.  
  
A certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Corporate Plus® member, Phase 3 has offices in Atlanta, Dallas, Nashville, and the New York City metropolitan area. Since its founding in 2001, Phase 3 has been recognized as a top company by *Inc. 5000,* *Printing Impressions,* *Atlanta Business Chronicle, and Nashville Business Journal*.  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
  
The Fractional Media Director serves as the senior strategic leader for Phase 3’s media practice, providing integrated media strategy, senior client counsel, team leadership and guidance on emerging channels and opportunities.  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced agency media professional who can move comfortably between high-level strategy, client conversations, team development and campaign oversight. The Media Director will lead strategy across a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C clients while helping the internal media team strengthen its strategic capabilities and deliver increasingly proactive recommendations.  
  
The ideal candidate brings broad experience across paid social, paid search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio, out-of-home and other media channels along with proficiency in website tracking across Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Experience with consumer brands and retail media networks such as Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect and Kroger Precision Marketing is highly desirable.  
  
**FRACTIONAL ENGAGEMENT STRUCTURE:**  
  
This is an ongoing fractional leadership engagement requiring approximately **4-5 hours per** **week/ 20 hours per month.** The Fractional Media Director will function as an integrated member of the Phase 3 team and senior leader of the media practice.  
  
The role offers flexibility in how hours are structured but requires consistent weekly availability for the media team, key client meetings, strategic planning sessions and new business opportunities, with 2-3 internal team meetings scheduled per week (not exceeding 2 hours total), monthly reporting calls with clients and the remaining time being used on-call, as needed.  
  
Work will be primarily remote with in-person participation at Phase 3’s Atlanta office and client meetings when valuable.  
  
The initial engagement is expected to be six months, with the opportunity to extend or expand the engagement based on business needs and growth of the media practice.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

**Media Strategy & Client Leadership**

  

* Provide senior strategic oversight across paid social, paid search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio, out-of-home, metasearch, retail media and emerging channels.
* Serve as Phase 3’s senior media advisor for key client relationships.
* Lead integrated media strategies connecting client business objectives, audiences, channels, investment and measurement.
* Guide annual, quarterly and campaign-specific media planning for key accounts.
* Evaluate channel mix, audience strategy, investment levels, KPIs and testing opportunities.
* Translate campaign performance and marketplace changes into actionable strategic recommendations.
* Lead or participate in strategic planning sessions, major presentations, quarterly business reviews and other senior-level client conversations.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, test new approaches and expand client media programs.

  

**Team Leadership & Development**

  

* Provide strategic leadership, coaching and mentorship to Phase 3’s internal media team.
* Develop team capabilities in integrated media strategy, planning, optimization, analytics and client communication.
* Establish clear roles and accountability across internal team members and specialized external media resources.
* Conduct regular account and strategy reviews and help team members move beyond performance reporting to meaningful insights and recommendations.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend training, tools or specialist support.
* Support agency leadership in assessing media capacity, staffing needs and longer-term organizational structure.
  

**Media Innovation & Performance**

  

* Stay current on changes in media technology, advertising platforms, consumer behavior, privacy, measurement and AI-enabled media buying.
* Help expand Phase 3’s capabilities in retail media, including Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Kroger Precision Marketing and other relevant networks.
* Evaluate emerging platforms and develop disciplined approaches to testing new channels.
* Provide senior oversight of campaign performance, optimization, budget pacing and investment strategy.
* Ensure media reporting clearly communicates what happened, why it happened and what actions should be taken.
* Establish consistent standards for media planning, QA, optimization, reporting and measurement.

  

**Growth & New Business**

  

* Partner with agency leadership, account teams and Sales to identify organic growth opportunities within existing client relationships.
* Participate in new-business discovery, media strategy development, pitches and presentations.
* Help develop media scopes, staffing approaches, management fees and investment recommendations.
* Strengthen Phase 3’s media capabilities, case studies and strategic points of view.
* Support the long-term growth and evolution of the media practice.
  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

**Required**

  

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive media experience, with significant experience in an advertising, media, digital or integrated agency environment.
* Recent practical, hands-on experience in advertising platforms including Google, Meta and LinkedIn.
* Previous experience in a Media Director, Group Media Director, VP of Media, Head of Media or comparable senior leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience developing integrated media strategies across multiple channels and platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of paid social, paid search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio and out-of-home.
* Strong understanding of audience strategy, media planning, measurement, attribution and performance analytics.
* Experience managing significant media investments and providing senior-level client counsel.
* Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring and developing media professionals.
* Experience directing specialized internal and external media resources.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and client communication skills.
* Strong commercial judgment and understanding of agency scope, staffing, client service and account profitability.
* Ability to provide consistent leadership, availability and accountability within a fractional structure.

  

**Preferred**

  

* Experience with CPG and consumer brands.
* Experience with retail media networks such as Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect and Kroger Precision Marketing.
* Experience with hospitality, travel or multi-location businesses.
* Experience with B2B media strategy and account-based marketing.
* Experience helping build or expand an agency media practice.
* Experience supporting agency new business and organic account growth.

  

**Successful Profile:**

  

* A senior strategist who sees the client’s broader business challenge rather than media as a collection of individual platforms.
* A confident client leader who can establish credibility with senior marketing executives.
* A proactive thinker who brings forward recommendations and opportunities before being asked.
* A collaborative leader who stays close enough to campaign execution to guide decisions, troubleshoot challenges and strengthen outcomes.
* A strong coach who develops team members rather than simply taking over their work.
* Broad media expertise combined with the judgment to know when specialized expertise is needed.
* Strong analytical instincts and the ability to translate performance data into meaningful business recommendations.
* Commercially minded, collaborative and comfortable operating within a lean team.
* Committed to developing people while helping build a more sophisticated, proactive and scalable media practice.

title: Director of Product Design
description:
Role Overview: Leads teams delivering UI/UX design solutions by defining user experience strategy, visual design standards, and interaction guidelines. Oversees requirements analysis and manages reviews of wireframes, prototypes, and design systems. Allocates resources for user research, usability testing, and accessibility audits. Reviews design documentation, user feedback, and compliance reports. Manages budgets for design tools, user testing platforms, and training. Ensures adherence to accessibility, branding, and industry standards. Mentors designers in user-centered design practices and iterative improvement, and represents the team in technical reviews, stakeholder meetings, and client presentations. Position Details:

McAfee is seeking a **Director of Product Design** to lead our product design and systems team, raise the bar for design quality, and help the organization deliver better product experiences with greater speed, consistency, and business impact.

This leader will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, and executive stakeholders to shape UX strategy, strengthen design operations, and integrate design earlier into planning and delivery. A key focus is advancing AI-driven product design workflows—improving how teams explore concepts, apply the design system, prototype, critique, QA, and hand off work to Engineering, including pushing beyond traditional Figma-based handoff toward more executable, implementation-ready outputs.

The role is also accountable for strengthening the design system as a foundation for scale, setting clear expectations through the levels and skills framework, and developing managers and senior ICs who can deliver high-quality, production-ready work.

What You’ll Do

* **Set UX strategy and direction** across multiple teams, connecting customer needs, business goals, product strategy, and measurable outcomes.

* **Advance AI-enabled product design workflows** that improve concept exploration, prototyping, design system application, critique, QA, and handoff—pushing the organization beyond static files toward more executable, implementation-ready deliverables.

* **Strengthen the design system** as a platform for consistency, efficiency, accessibility, reusable patterns, implementation fidelity, and cross-platform quality.

* **Raise the quality of design deliverables** by defining what “excellent” looks like across flows, edge cases, interaction details, content, accessibility, specifications, and engineering handoff.

* **Build operational excellence** through stronger planning, prioritization, design reviews, decision-making, documentation, and cross-functional alignment.

* **Lead and influence cross-functionally** with Product, Engineering, Research, Marketing, Data, and executive stakeholders to align strategy, scope, trade-offs, and delivery plans.

* **Grow talent and design culture** by coaching managers and senior ICs, applying the levels and skills framework, and building a culture of ownership, feedback, high craft, and measurable outcomes.

What You Bring

* 10+ years of product design experience, including leadership of managers, senior ICs, or multiple design teams.

* Proven ability to set strategy, translate ambiguity into clear priorities, and connect design work to customer and business outcomes.

* Strong experience with design systems, reusable patterns, cross-platform design, and design-to-engineering handoff.

* Practical fluency with AI-enabled product design workflows and strong judgment about where AI can improve speed, quality, system adoption, and implementation readiness versus where human craft must lead.

* Track record of raising design quality, delivery discipline, operational effectiveness, and implementation fidelity across teams.

* Experience using research, data, experimentation, and customer insight to guide product direction and validate decisions.

* Strong executive communication, storytelling, stakeholder management, and cross-functional influence.

* Experience mentoring and developing design managers, senior designers, and future design leaders against clear level expectations.

* Commitment to inclusive design, accessibility, privacy, trust, and responsible AI practices.

Success Looks Like

* Teams deliver higher-quality work with clearer expectations, stronger rituals, and better handoff.

* AI-enabled product design workflows improve concept exploration, prototyping, design system usage, critique, QA, and engineering handoff quality.

* The design system reduces inconsistency, rework, and implementation ambiguity.

* Design is engaged earlier in planning and contributes more directly to product strategy and business outcomes.

* Managers and designers understand what great looks like at their level and have clearer paths for growth.

title: Campaign and Media Director
description:
Overview:

Help tell the story of America's longest war**.** As Campaign and Media Director, you'll shape how the nation hears the Afghanistan War Commission's findings on two decades of U.S. decisions in Afghanistan, leading a high-profile campaign from launch through the release of the Commission's final report to Congress.

The Campaign and Media Director leads the full range of strategic communications, public engagement, digital, content, event, media monitoring, and data visualization support for the Afghanistan War Commission. The Director helps the Commission reach the media, key stakeholders, and the public, with emphasis on the rollout of the Commission's final report to Congress. The Director works collaboratively with Commission staff to ensure all work products meet the needs of the Commission, Commissioners, and staff.

FWI is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Top Workplace by the Washington Post, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.

**Work Schedule and Location:**

**Remote**: This part-time remote position will work Monday through Friday, with approximately 20 hours a week, with an expected increase in Summer 2027. Travel may be required for meetings, conferences, and rollout events.

  
Responsibilities:

**Strategic Communications and Media Strategy**

* Work with AWC senior staff to develop and execute the Commission's national security–focused media messaging strategy, including social media engagement.
* Advise senior staff on the Government's use of social media platforms, including which platforms are restricted and how each platform retains and preserves data.
* Recommend and facilitate engagement with media outlets to promote the final report and other releases and events before and after the report's release.
* Provide expert counsel on brand development, public positioning, visibility, reputation risk management, and media engagement.
* Research specific articles, reporters, and outlets as needed.

**Digital Content and Web Development**

* Lead the design and development of an enhanced AWC website and online presence so users can easily access and navigate the lengthy final report and collateral materials. This work draws on WordPress, UX/UI and web design, and interactive approaches to large-scale data visualization.
* Post on, edit, and otherwise manage AWC social media accounts at the direction of senior staff.
* Track social media analytics and advise on growing followers and improving visibility.

**Content Development and Production**

* Prepare, coordinate, and execute digital newsletter and social media campaigns for public awareness, data collection (as approved by senior staff), and event notifications.
* Oversee the production of video, digital, and graphic materials such as infographics.
* Prepare media materials, including press kits, background materials, press releases, talking points, and presentations.
* Advise on and provide technical support for the final report publication, including writing, editing, design, and formatting.

**Public Event Coordination and Support**

* Plan, execute, and facilitate hearings, press conferences, interviews, podcasts, conferences, forums, roundtables, media availabilities, and other public events.
* Respond to media inquiries and schedule interviews.
* Help track compliance with the AWC's Media and Publication guidelines.
* Provide media training for Commissioners and Commission staff.

**Media Monitoring and Analysis**

* Alert AWC staff to breaking news relevant to the Commission's work and prepare response advice as needed.
* Provide regular media updates and summaries of relevant news, trends, and articles, as directed by senior staff.
* Measure and analyze coverage of the AWC across traditional, social, and other media, using parameters set by the overall communications strategy.

**Data Visualization Support**

* Oversee the creation of accurate, innovative charts, graphs, dashboards, timelines, maps, and other visuals for print and digital use, based on AWC data and guidance.
* Manage an intensive editing process with AWC, incorporating and reconciling frequent changes and independently validating visualization integrity.
* Coordinate with the AWC's designated print report publisher to integrate finalized visualizations.

Qualifications:

Required:

* Bachelor's degree
* Proficiency with WordPress platforms and interactive or illustrative approaches to large-scale data visualization.
* At least 6 years' demonstrated ability in media relations, content production (written, video, digital, graphic), event management, media training, and media analysis.

Desired:

* Experience engaging the U.S. military, national security agencies, Congress, veterans communities, and national and international media.
* Knowledge of and connections within the Afghanistan War, military affairs, veterans affairs, and foreign policy communities. The Director should be able to use these to launch the AWC's media presence quickly and effectively.
* In-depth understanding of national security and foreign policy audiences, and command of current communications technologies and best practices.

**FWI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.**

Why Join Our Team:

At FWI, we place the highest importance on creating an exceptional employee experience. description:
**About Lovesac**

We are a young-at-heart, fast-growing furniture company, dedicated to helping people fill their homes with Total Comfort™. We do this by designing and innovating furniture solutions that are adaptable, washable, expandable, and delivered right-to-your-door-able, allowing our customers to live the life they want to live.

Our Designed for Life mission started with Sacs, a seat so much better than your classic beanbag made with repurposed Durafoam and designed to reduce environmental impact while providing unimaginable, cloud-like comfort. From there, we expanded the possibility for sustainable furniture with Sactionals, a customizable modular sectional that can be endlessly rearranged to evolve with you. Our product line has grown a lot since our Sacs days, but our goal will always remain the same – to create truly adaptable, comfortable furniture that can be with you for life.

**About our Culture**

At Lovesac, we strive to be an employer of choice by embodying a culture that encourages team members to think and dream big. We call this Top Ambition. We aim to not only excel within our industry but also make a meaningful impact on the world. Above all else, we’re driven by love (because it matters) and are dedicated to promoting love and happiness in all aspects of our work. It’s about success, of course, but it’s also about making a positive impact on everyone our business touches.

TheSenior Director, Creative - Content, Community & Culture is a strategic and creative leader responsible for defining and driving the brand’s entry to lifestyle through a social first content strategy, wholistic channel strategy approach to build fandom, while enhancing the brands relevance through energy driving activities that connect to culture such as partnerships and activations. This leader will build compelling, culturally relevant content based on insights, that inspires new customers to engage with the brand, strengthens brand affinity, drives engagement, and ultimately supports traffic, conversion, and customer loyalty.

This role brings together insights, brand storytelling, social strategy, content creation, community engagement, and activation orchestration – while working closely with creators/influencers, and emerging channels to create a cohesive and differentiated brand experience that compliments Lovesac’s product marketing.

The Senior Director will partner closely with Integrated & Product Marketing, Brand, Creative, E-Commerce, Merchandising, Retail, PR/Communications and external agency partners to translates business priorities and customer insights into high-impact brand moments.

This position is remote and will report into Lovesac Corporate HUB based in Stamford, CT.

Candidates must fully reside in the United States at all times during employment and should have the ability to travel as needed.

**What You’ll Do**

**Turn Insights Into Action**

* Leverage consumer and culture insights to drive brand actions and content strategies to build relevance and engagement.
* Define and evolve the social first content strategy that transforms Lovesac into a lifestyle brand.
* Establish content pillars, frameworks, editorial calendars, and channel strategies to drive engagement.
* Oversee content development across social, editorial, activation, talent, and collabs.
* Ensure content consistently reflects the brand voice, visual identity, values, and customer-centric positioning.

**Social Media & Community Engagement**

* Own the enterprise social strategy across relevant platforms, including organic and emerging social channels.
* Lead strategies that are brand building and grow meaningful engagement, reach, community, and relevance.
* Oversee the development of content that balances entertainment & world building while fostering UGC growth and fan voices.
* Develop an active community management strategy that strengthens customer connectivity and creates opportunities for two-way engagement – QTM and surprise and delight response.
* Identify cultural and industry trends, social behaviors, consumer insights and emerging platforms that can create new opportunities for the brand.
* Establish social listening and engagement practices to bring customer sentiment and trends back into the organization.

**Creator & Influencer Content**

* Develop and scale a creator and influencer content strategy in partnership with PR/Communications and Integrated Marketing.
* Build concepts and narratives that turn influencer touchpoints into brand building, social-first campaigns and activations.
* Support the identification of creators and cultural partners who authentically align with the brand in driving relevance with affinities.
* Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate content for effectiveness, engagement, reach, and business impact.

**Content Operations & Creative Leadership**

* Lead and inspire a high-performing team of content, activations and social media professionals.
* Establish culture & QTM processes that coincides the seasonal process - to enable the organization to move quickly when needed while maintaining quality and brand consistency as well.
* Partner with internal creative teams and external agencies, production partners, and creators to deliver high-quality content at scale.
* Develop content production strategies that maximize the value and reuse of content across channels.
* Balance speed, creativity, quality, and budget to drive efficient ideas.

**Customer Insights & Creative Expression**

* Translate customer behaviors, motivations, unmet needs, and cultural signals into distinctive creative territories, content ideas, and brand experiences.
* Define how customer insights are expressed through storytelling, visual language, tone, and experiences that make the brand more relevant, memorable, and emotionally resonant.
* Use social listening, community feedback, performance signals, and direct customer learning to inspire creative briefs and identify new opportunities for content, collaborations, and activations.
* Champion creative experimentation that brings the Lovesac lifestyle to life in fresh, culturally relevant ways while remaining grounded in the brand’s voice, values, and customer promise.
* Create a continuous learning loop between customer response and creative development, using insights to sharpen expression, improve relevance, and deepen brand affinity over time.

**Strategy, Analytics & Business Impact**

* Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks for overall brand health in addition to content, social, engagement, and community performance.
* Use analytics, customer insights, social listening, and testing to optimize content strategy and investment.
* Translate data & customer insights into actionable recommendations for marketing and business leaders.
* Connect content and engagement performance to broader brand, traffic, acquisition, conversion, and loyalty objectives.
* Stay ahead of evolving industry trends, social platforms, technology, AI, content formats, and consumer behaviors to position Lovesac and best in class marketing.

**Investment Strategy & Budget Oversight**

* Own the investment strategy and annual budget across content, social, community, creators, partnerships, activations, production, and agency support, ensuring resources are aligned to enterprise priorities and growth objectives.
* Build business cases and investment recommendations that connect customer insights, cultural opportunities, and channel performance to measurable brand and commercial outcomes.

* Monitor spend, commitments, and performance against plan; identify risks and trade-offs early and reallocate investment based on business needs, effectiveness, and return on investment.
* Partner with Marketing and Finance leadership to communicate budget performance, investment decisions, and expected business impact with clarity and accountability.
* Negotiate and manage agency, production, creator, and partner investments to maximize value, scalability, and quality while maintaining disciplined financial stewardship.

* Partner with senior leaders across Marketing, Creative, Merchandising, E-Commerce, Retail, PR, Customer Insights, and Product.

* Experience leading designers while remaining an active practitioner who directly tackles complex design problems
* Practical experience designing AI-enabled or automated workflows with sound judgment around human review and error recovery

title: Director, Product & Pipeline Communications - Hematology
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

**General Description:**

**The Director, Product & Pipeline Communications - Hematology** is responsible for developing and leading the global communications strategy for BeOne’s Hematology franchise, encompassing commercialized products and pipeline assets across stages of development and lifecycle maturity.

Operating with a global and enterprise mindset, this leader sets global communications direction informed by regional priorities, stakeholder insights, competitive dynamics and market needs.

The Director ensures product & pipeline communications support business and scientific objectives while contributing to BeOne’s broader corporate brand, scientific credibility and reputation. The role looks beyond individual products and milestones to connect the portfolio’s science, innovation, leadership and patient impact to a coherent understanding of BeOne worldwide.

The Director serves as the strategic communications counselor to Corporate Affairs, Global Product and Global Brand leadership, and the Chief Medical Officer, Hematology. The role is responsible for the Chief Medical Officer’s thought leadership and executive visibility strategy and helps position BeOne’s scientific and medical leaders as credible, authoritative voices in oncology and patient care.

The position partners closely with the Corporate Communications and Media Relations team members to align product & pipeline communications with BeOne’s corporate narrative, global external communications strategy, earned media priorities, issues preparedness and enterprise reputation objectives.

**Essential Functions:**

**Global Franchise Communications Strategy**

* Partner with the Executive Director, Corporate Brand & Reputation, to develop and lead a comprehensive, measurable global communications strategy for the Hematology franchise, encompassing pipeline assets, launch priorities, commercialized products and lifecycle opportunities.
* Set global direction informed by regional priorities, market conditions, stakeholder needs and cultural context, and create mechanisms for regional insights to shape enterprise planning.
* Develop and steward an integrated franchise narrative and message architecture across assets and lifecycle stages, ensuring global consistency while enabling appropriate regional adaptation.
* Build and execute an annual communications plan with clear goals, objectives, audiences, strategies, key initiatives (e.g., communications materials, digital content, unbranded disease state education campaigns), budgets, and measures of success.
* Identify opportunities to demonstrate BeOne’s scientific expertise and contributions in Hematology beyond major data releases, regulatory milestones and product announcements, including medical and patient impact stories that can generate credible external interest and reinforce BeOne’s corporate reputation.
* Partner with the Media Relations team member to develop proactive and milestone-related earned media strategies for the Hematology franchise and provide franchise expertise, context, messaging and executive access needed to support high-quality media engagement.
* Provide ongoing strategic counsel to the broader Corporate Affairs team, Global Product and Global Brand leadership, and cross-functional partners regarding communications opportunities, tradeoffs and reputation considerations.

**Product, Pipeline and Lifecycle Communications**

* Lead global communications planning and execution across the Hematology portfolio lifecycle, from early development through pivotal data, regulatory milestones, launch, commercialization and lifecycle management.
* Develop strategies and materials for clinical data readouts, publications, regulatory decisions, product launches, indication expansions and other significant milestones.
* Translate complex scientific concepts, mechanisms of action and clinical data into clear, accurate and compelling narratives tailored to priority audiences.
* Partner with Commercial, Medical Affairs, R&D, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, Market Access and Patient Advocacy teams to ensure coordinated and compliant execution.
* Develop branded and unbranded disease education and multichannel storytelling programs that increase understanding and demonstrate potential impact for people living with blood cancer.

**Medical Congresses and Scientific Engagement**

* Lead global communications strategy and execution for priority medical congresses and scientific meetings to drive impact of BeOne’s science and leadership.
* Develop integrated plans supporting the Hematology franchise narrative and key data releases, inclusive of media engagement, potential booth activation, executive visibility, digital content and internal communications.
* Oversee congress messaging, press materials, executive preparation, and internal readouts.
* Collaborate with R&D communications colleagues to grow awareness and understanding of BeOne’s scientific expertise and ongoing clinical programs to expand into new indications.

**Chief Medical Officer Thought Leadership and Executive Visibility**

* Serve as the primary communications counselor to the Chief Medical Officer, Hematology and other priority scientific and medical leaders within the Hematology franchise.
* Develop and execute a sustained thought leadership and executive visibility strategy aligned with the Chief Medical Officer’s expertise, franchise priorities and BeOne’s corporate narrative.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities for media engagement, speaking platforms, scientific forums, bylines, social content, awards and other external visibility.
* Support the development of executive messaging, briefing materials, and talking points for external engagements.
* Partner with the Corporate Communications and Media Relations team members to ensure CMO visibility supports enterprise thought leadership, executive visibility and earned media strategies.
* Prepare and counsel scientific leaders for high-profile engagements, balancing scientific rigor, audience relevance, business context and reputation considerations.

**Issues Preparedness and Reputation Management**

* Operate beyond franchise and product silos and consider how communications decisions affect BeOne’s overall reputation, scientific standing and stakeholder trust.
* Monitor scientific, competitive, regulatory and stakeholder developments that may create communications opportunities or reputation risks for the franchise.
* Anticipate potential issues, develop response materials and ensure franchise leaders and communications partners are prepared for sensitive developments.
* Partner with the Media Relations team member on issues assessment, escalation, response planning and crisis communications related to the franchise.

**Measurement, Resources and Operations**

* Define and track metrics related to narrative and message pull-through, stakeholder engagement, executive visibility, media quality and reputation outcomes.
* Use data, stakeholder insights and competitive intelligence to evaluate performance and improve strategy and execution.
* Manage Hematology franchise communications budgets, agency partners, scopes, deliverables and spending with discipline and accountability.
* Ensure communications materials and activities meet medical, legal, regulatory, privacy and compliance requirements.
* Balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution and support team priorities beyond the assigned franchise when enterprise needs require.

**Minimum Requirements – Education and Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree required

title: Director of Evaluation Services
description:
Overview:

**This position is open until filled with an initial application review to take place on October 15, 2026**

**The starting salary range for this position is $11,068.75 - $12,320.00**

**per month depending upon qualifications and is non-negotiable.**

**FUNCTION OF THE UNIT**
========================

Academy for Professional Excellence, a project of San Diego State University School of Social Work, was established in 1996 with the goal of revolutionizing the way people work to ensure the world is a healthier place. Our services integrate culturally responsive and recovery-oriented practices into our daily work to promote healing and healthy relationships. Providing approximately 50,000 learning experiences to health and human service and justice system professionals annually, the Academy provides a variety of workforce development solutions in Southern California and beyond. With seven programs, three divisions and over 100 staff, the Academy’s mission is to provide exceptional learning and development experiences for the transformation of individuals, organizations, and communities.

As a member of the Academy team you will be engaging in communal development of heart, mind, and practice. You are expected to foster culturally responsive practice behaviors to promote well-being and a culture that focuses on healing, healthy relationships and changed behaviors.

The Strategy, Development, and Organizational Advancement (SDOA) division brings together several functional areas under one structure to support the Academy's vision. Using data and research, SDOA designs learning experiences, develops products, and creates systems that strengthen organizational culture and reinforce the Academy's brand. The division leads the implementation of the Academy's strategic plan and provides insights and recommendations to improve the Academy's products, services, staff development, and partnerships with service providers.

The Evaluation Services team (within SDOA) provides evaluation design and instrument creation, logic modeling, analysis, and actionable insights through reporting and dashboards. Evaluation data infrastructure support, including programming/distribution of survey instruments and data collection processes and practices rooted in the Data Equity Framework to ensure equity, fairness, and justice within evaluation and data projects.

Responsibilities:

**PURPOSE OF THE POSITION**
===========================

Under the general direction of the Senior Director of Strategy, Development, & Organizational Advancement, the **Director of Evaluation Services** is responsible for the strategic direction and oversight of the Evaluation Services team. The Director will lead the creation and management of the Academy's evaluation infrastructure, systems, and protocols. The Director will guide the Evaluation Services team, Academy programs and divisions, and external partners in meeting evaluation needs, including participating in and overseeing the development, revision, and implementation of evaluation procedures; overseeing the design and testing of evaluation methodology and tools for data collection; development and maintenance of internal and external data systems, analysis of evaluation data, and production of evaluation reports.

The Director of Evaluation Services is responsible for overseeing progress to meet yearly strategic priorities related to evaluation and to meet State, regional, and individual program goals and evaluation deliverables. Serves as a program administrator for evaluation, provides strategic leadership in planning evaluation to determine the broad impact of the Academy for Professional Excellence programs and deliverables.

The Director of Evaluation Services will make decisions and oversee recommendations and actions regarding the use of evaluation systems and will create, develop, innovate, maintain, and monitor databases that house training and evaluation data; train support staff on evaluation and tracking procedures; and conduct and oversee statistical analyses of evaluation data.

This position will plan, organize, and direct the work of 10+ employees; and participate in and/or make effective recommendations on hiring, retaining, performance management, and staff development.

**SPECIFIC DUTIES**
===================

This is a 40-hour-a-week hybrid with remote flexibility position, typically working M-F from 8:00 to 4:30 p.m., and is based on contract funding subject to annual renewal. The position may be subject to intermittent overnight travel and work shifts outside of normal business hours, including weekends and evenings if needed.

This position requires that you reside within California throughout the duration of your employment and live within a commutable distance from the worksite your work supports. Positions are typically assigned to either our Riverside or San Diego office for any on-site work.

Note: some duties may include working with and/or exposure to sensitive/traumatic topics or material dealing with child abuse, abuse against older adults and adults with disabilities, and/or issues and scenarios related to mental health, substance use, or racism.

The Academy is a project of the San Diego State University Research Foundation, which is grant-funded and serves as an auxiliary to the University. The Academy is based near, but not on campus, and does not have direct responsibilities for working with or teaching college students.

The Academy is currently going through a reclassification process. If this position’s classification changes during this process, it would not change the role, responsibilities, or compensation of the position.

**EVALUATION SERVICES MANAGEMENT (55%)**

  

* Oversee evaluation management for each Academy for Professional Excellence program (APSWI, CWDS, CRS, LIA, SACHS, Tribal STAR, WI and Academy), inclusive of strategic planning, conceptualizing, developing, implementing, and analyzing evaluation data.
* Oversee work with each Program Manager to develop tailored evaluation plans for each program for each fiscal year, inclusive of: a working logic model, action plan, identified goals, strategies, and development of new measures.
* Oversee and design evaluation methodology to determine feasibility of transfer of learning and intent to use to improved outcomes for Academy programs and associated workforce development projects.
* Oversee and contribute to the development of data collection procedures, protocols, and practices for Academy evaluation.
* Oversee preparation of quarterly, ad hoc, and annual evaluation analyses and the writing and presentation of state and county evaluation reports.
* Serve as a liaison between CACWT Administration, CalEval, and systems partners to ensure data needs, reporting requirements, data governance, and system enhancements are aligned with statewide workforce development goals.
* Determine and implement methods of use of evaluation data systems (including but not limited to SPSS, Qualtrics, NVIVO, Excel, SumTotal Learning Management System, SQL/Access databases)
* Determine and oversee production and maintenance of data quality, data collection, and analysis processes.
* Oversee team strategic planning, ensuring alignment to the Academy strategic plan, with an emphasis on how evaluation can support organizational growth, efficiency, and innovation.
* Collaborate with Program Managers and the Senior Director of Finance and Business Services to provide infrastructure, scopes of work, evaluation workflow, technology, and contract direction specific to evaluation staff resource allocation and budget, and work to ensure all contract deliverables are resourced and met.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert in key statewide workgroups, upholding and contributing to the CalWise Evaluation charter and promoting key strategies to advance statewide evaluation and data systems capabilities.
* Interface with a variety of partners across the state, including but not limited to CDSS partners, staff from other Regional Training Academies, SDSU School of Social Work, Division of Research and Innovation, and SDSU Research Foundation.
* Anticipate, forecast, and plan for changes in evaluation practices, understanding trends to recommend and integrate innovations and systems efficiencies.
* Act as internal consultant and subject matter expert for the Academy, providing guidance, recommendations, and making decisions on evaluation practice, systems, data use, data storage, and integration.

**TEAM MANAGEMENT AND SUPERVISION (30%)**

  

* Provide day-to-day oversight for Evaluation Services strategy and operations.
* Provide personnel management to direct report(s) including: monitoring performance, providing feedback, holding regular supervision conferences, and facilitating professional development for direct reports.
* Participate in recruitment and onboarding of new staff as directed by Organizational Development and SDSURF Human Resources.
* Conduct annual performance evaluations of direct report(s).
* Address performance concerns of direct report(s) in conjunction with SDSURF Human Resources, Organizational Development, and appropriate line of supervision.
* Convene monthly Evaluation Team meetings – revisit/track progress on action plan, facilitate communication re: workloads, current projects underway, communicate decisions from management teams (and any other updates that impact evaluation)
* Communicate with staff regularly to keep them apprised of decisions made at Leadership Team meetings (or other venues) that impact them.
* Advocate on behalf of the evaluation services team at all staffing levels, when working collaboratively, and in various meetings; always be thinking of implications for staff and be proactive in terms of planning for resource needs to complete deliverables.
* Establish a workflow via project management software for direct reports and other evaluation staff.
* Train support staff on evaluation systems, technology, and procedures.
* Assist in planning, organizing, and implementing evaluation activities outside of database/dashboard needs
* Develop and monitor evaluation protocols for collecting and processing evaluation data.

**EVALUATION DESIGN/METHODOLOGY/ANALYSIS (5%)**

  

* Advise and collaborate with the evaluation team in determining the best course of action for any given evaluation project that will utilize a data system.
* Advise and assist in determining methodology, techniques, systems, and procedures for meeting the evaluation needs of Academy programs.
* Assist in conducting statistical analyses of evaluation data and produce data and evaluation reports.

**OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED (5%)**

* Perform other duties as assigned which are in the best interests of the Academy for Professional Excellence.
* Travel to off-site locations for Academy and Program meetings (primarily in Riverside and San Diego).

**ACADEMY SHARED LEADERSHIP TEAM (5%)**

* Participate on the Academy's Shared Leadership Team.
* Engage in strategic planning and decision-making regarding issues impacting organizational culture, growth, and expansion.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SPECIAL SKILLS**
===================================

**Knowledge and Abilities:**

* Executive presence; self-starter with a keen sense of ownership and commitment to the work; and a passion for delivering results.
* Proven ability to lead others by example, demonstrating organizational values and fidelity to the System of Practice.
* Ability to demonstrate a high level of cross-cultural sensitivity.
* Understanding of program administration, budget development, and management.
* Advanced ability to think and plan strategically, and to facilitate consensus to align organizational strategies with the mission, vision, and values.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines including project and process management skills.
* Display collaborative and inclusive leadership and work style.
* Advanced ability to work effectively and diplomatically across a diverse spectrum of internal and external stakeholders to achieve goals.
* Ability to generate and champion new ideas, approaches, and initiatives, and create an environment that nurtures and supports innovation.

Qualifications:

**MINIMUM EDUCATION**

  
Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent training and relevant work experience involving study, analysis, and/or evaluation leading to the development or improvement of administrative policies, procedures, practices, or programs.  



**MINIMUM EXPERIENCE**

  

* 8 years of progressively responsible experience in an office or administrative environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience partnering with California Department of Social Services, California Regional Academies, CalEval and Health and Human Services agencies in Southern California.
* Expertise with Qualtrics and related programming.
* Knowledge of SPSS and the Sum Total and CACWT Learning Management Systems
