title: Senior Director, Platform Prioritization & Delivery
description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we're enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for a Senior Director to own cross-functional prioritization and delivery across Mission Lane, reporting to the SVP, Product, Platform, & Delivery

**The impact you'll make:**

Every initiative Mission Lane ships – a better payment plan, a faster credit decision, a clearer way to see progress - moves a customer forward. None of it ships in a vacuum. It depends on the right team picking it up at the right time, with the capacity to see it through, without adversely affecting another initiative.

The system that sorts through those prioritization decisions is yours to run. You'll manage the framework and facilitate the discussions that decide what goes first when domains are moving at different speeds and carrying different risks. You'll often be bringing a room full of different perspectives to a shared answer.

This function is new at Mission Lane, and the framework for it is only partly in place. You're the one who fills in what's missing and runs it day to day, building the credibility that earns trust and adherence.

**What you'll own:**

* A team of four Delivery Managers, each embedded in a different focus area (Collections, Data & AI/Model Process, Portfolio Management, and Acquisitions), including their coaching, growth, and workload balance
* The prioritization tracker as Mission Lane's single source of truth for what's in flight, at what stage, and why, kept accurate enough that leaders trust it without double-checking
* Weekly prioritization meetings, MBRs, and QBRs, run with enough rigor to hold up under executive scrutiny
* Company-wide delivery standards, frameworks, and tooling that initiative teams actually adopt in their day-to-day work
* Cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Credit, Marketing, Finance, and Legal/Compliance, clearing blockers and resolving trade-offs before they stall delivery
* Post-initiative retrospectives that produce concrete changes to how the next initiative gets planned and delivered

**You'll thrive in this role if:**

* You've led delivery inside an organization with genuine cross-functional complexity, spanning multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
* You've built a prioritization or delivery process yourself, and can explain the tradeoffs in it clearly enough that someone new to it can follow the logic.
* Your background is in product, program, or technical delivery leadership, with the credibility to work as a peer with engineering leads and data scientists.
* You build just enough process to protect capacity and speed, no more.
* You have direct conversations with senior stakeholders when priorities conflict, and you know how to bring a room to a decision.

**Minimum qualifications:**

* A proven track record of building processes and oversight to drive improved speed to impact across an organization.
* A proven track record leading and developing a team focused on organizational effectiveness which could include Delivery Managers, Program Managers, or similarly scoped delivery leaders
* Experience working in a highly regulated and technical environment, with demonstrated ability to shape functional strategy and operate with a high degree of autonomy
* Experience owning enterprise-level portfolio intake, prioritization, and execution tracking end to end, at a company operating at meaningful scale and complexity
* A demonstrated ability to align senior and executive stakeholders across functions such as Product, Engineering, Finance, Credit, and Legal around shared priorities without relying on direct authority
* Deep working knowledge of modern delivery methodologies and the judgment to adapt them to an organization's actual stage of maturity as well as rapidly changing technology
* Experience structuring and running core enterprise operating cadences, such as weekly prioritization meetings, MBRs, and QBRs, that senior leadership relies on for accurate decision-making
* Hands-on experience with modern portfolio and workflow tooling (e.g., Jira, Jira Align, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet), including evaluating and administering these tools at an organizational level
* A background that includes hiring, coaching, and developing direct reports
* Ability to travel ~4+ times per year for high quality in person collaboration

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Direct experience in consumer lending, credit cards, or another regulated financial services environment, with working knowledge of compliance, credit risk, and legal considerations that shape delivery timelines
* Experience scaling delivery governance and team structures inside a fast-growing, mid-sized organization moving through a similar stage of process maturity
* Expertise configuring enterprise-grade portfolio tools (e.g., Jira Align, Dragonboat, Productboard) to connect strategic goals directly to team execution
* Experience building portfolio dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to track delivery velocity, resource utilization, and realized business impact

**Compensation:**

Annual full-time starting base salary range: $196,000 - $243,000

This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.

Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

**About Mission Lane:**

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn't have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn't do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.

Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

**Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.**

Mission Lane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status.

Mission Lane provides reasonable accommodations to applicants who need them for medical or religious reasons, as required by law. Applicants can initiate an accommodation request by contacting peopleexperience@missionlane.com.

Mission Lane is not sponsoring new applicant employment authorization and please, no third-party recruiters.

**Application Integrity:**

Our cardholders trust us with their financial well-being, and this trust starts with the integrity of the people on our team. We're looking for team members who share our dedication to transparency and truth. Please verify that the information in your application is accurate and complete.

*Providing any information to Mission Lane that is not completely truthful at any point during the application or hiring process may result in removal from the hiring process, disqualification from future opportunities, withdrawal of an offer or other sanctions for candidates and, in addition for employees, disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.*

Fundación Cuenta Conmigo is a nonprofit foundation created to support low-income families with a family member suffering from cancer in the Chilean public health system. Specifically, the foundation assists families navigating the process of their child’s cancer treatment. This includes covering expenses and helping address needs that are not supported by the State or other non-governmental institutions. This organization is near and dear to Ana Wainer’s heart. Her son, Dante’s, close friend, Vicente, was diagnosed with pre-leukemia at age 9. After long and exhausting treatment, he underwent a bone marrow transplant. Unfortunately, it was not successful. Vicente later relapsed with Acute Myeloid Leukemia, "a diagnosis that profoundly changed the lives of his family and of all of us who knew him and accompanied them throughout the process,” Ana says. At age 11, after a long and courageous battle, Vincente passed away. “Despite the deep sorrow, Vicente left us invaluable life lessons and opened our eyes to a reality that often remains invisible to much of society,” Ana says. Shortly after his passing in March 2019, Vicente’s parents founded Fundación Cuenta Conmigo in 2020. Ana was a co-founder of the foundation and served as a volunteer member on the board of directors for three years. Through her role at Lockton, she coordinated activities between Lockton and the foundation as part of their Christmas initiatives since 2022. “From the moment I introduced the foundation at Lockton, the company was very open to collaborating and the response was overwhelmingly positive,” Ana says. “When I invited my colleagues to participate as volunteers, everyone showed a genuine interest in helping in any way needed.” Ana’s love and dedication towards this foundation have been recognized by Lockton, earning her the Lockton Cares Community Impact Award for the Latin America region. This award celebrates Lockton Associates across the globe who go above and beyond to improve their communities through volunteering and philanthropy. Each recipient can direct a $25,000 donation to a charity of their choice, funded directly by the Lockton family. “As first I was genuinely surprised to hear my name, followed by a deep sense of emotion, pride, and gratitude,” Ana explains. The award funds were used to purchase a brand-new utility vehicle, which is now used to distribute the various donations the foundation receives and delivers to families undergoing treatment in public hospitals. Donations include food, Christmas gifts, medical supplies, orthopedic equipment, and other essential items as needs arise. Ana had to step down from her role on the board of directors, but this award represents the support she wished she could have continued providing. “I feel like it is a kind of legacy that Lockton helped me leave for the foundation, for Vicente, and for his family,” she says. As she becomes more familiar with Lockton culture, Ana says it was a pleasant surprise to see that the importance of culture is not something just written on paper, but something truly reflected in the company’s commitment to charitable causes around the world. “Lockton genuinely cares,” Ana says. It’s no secret how much this foundation means to Ana, and she will continue contributing and encourage more people show support in any way they can. Fundación Cuenta Conmiga gave Ana an opportunity to discover an unfamiliar world—one that anyone could find themselves in one day. “It taught me to value what I have,” she says. “To be more empathetic toward those going through difficult times."

title: Government Cost Accountant
description:
Description:

Elevate your career with Detroit Defense. Join a dynamic team dedicated to national security through cutting-edge technology. Detroit Defense has a long history of delivering advanced solutions to the Department of War (DOW). Dive into innovation in Systems Engineering, Combat Vehicle Integration, Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics and Software Development. Your journey to impactful work and rapid growth starts now—Behind the Mission Beyond the Challenge!

Detroit Defense is seeking a Government Cost Accountant to provide integral, hands-on support to the Controller and Director of FP&A across our cost accounting structure in Deltek Costpoint. The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) owns the company's indirect rate structure, cost allowability determinations, and incurred cost submission, with critical input of the Director of FP&A and the Controller; this role provides the analytical and execution support beneath that leadership team – supporting operational accounting as needed, and performing the reconciliations, data checks, and schedule preparation that let the CFO and their team make and defend those calls with confidence. This position focuses on confirming that labor, cost, and organizational data are captured completely, accurately, and consistently as they flow through Costpoint.

The Government Cost Accountant reports directly to the Controller and works closely with FP&A, Program Finance, Contracts, and other departments to keep our cost structure compliant, reconcilable, and audit-ready.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Cost Pool & Indirect Rate Management (Deltek Costpoint) – Support Role**

* Support the Controller/Director of FP&A in maintaining and reconciling the company's indirect cost pools (fringe, overhead, G&A) in Costpoint, ensuring pool cost accounts are mapped to the correct account/organization combinations at the lowest level costs are actually posted.
* Perform the monthly and year-end calculation and reconciliation of actual indirect rates against provisional/billing rates; research variances and bring findings to the Controller/Director of FP&A for review and resolution.
* Provide supporting analysis and data for provisional billing rate development and annual rate budgets, which are set by the CFO with support from the Accounting Team.
* Help confirm the allocation base for each pool (e.g., direct labor dollars, total cost input, modified total direct costs) is applied consistently, flagging any inconsistency for leadership and/or third-party review.

**Deltek Costpoint Organization & Department Structure – Support Role**

* Provide hands-on support maintaining the Costpoint organization/department structure (home organizations, cost centers, org hierarchy) under the direction of the Controller/Director of FP&A, so that costs post to the correct pool and cost objective from the point of entry.
* Assist in evaluating the downstream cost pool and rate impact of any proposed organizational or account structure change, and raise findings to the Controller/Director of FP&A before a change is implemented.
* Maintain documentation of the current organization/department structure and its relationship to the indirect rate structure for leadership's reference.

**Cost Allowability & Compliance – Support Role**

* Apply FAR Part 31 cost principles – allowability (FAR 31.201-2), reasonableness (FAR 31.201-3), and allocability (FAR 31.201-4) – to flag and document proposed cost treatment for review and final determination by the Accounting Team.
* Identify and segregate expressly unallowable costs per FAR 31.205 into designated unallowable cost accounts, escalating any ambiguous or edge-case determinations to leadership.
* Apply Cost Accounting Standards (CAS 401, 402, 405, 406, 418) consistently in day-to-day cost treatment, and surface any inconsistency or proposed change in practice to the Accounting Team for review; the CAS Disclosure Statement is owned by the CFO.
* Support maintenance of written cost accounting policies and unallowable-cost determination documentation under the direction of the Accounting Team.

**Incurred Cost Submission (ICE Model) – Support Role**

* Provide the primary data preparation and reconciliation support for the annual Incurred Cost Submission (ICS), which is owned and filed by the CFO with support from the Accounting Team – building the indirect rate schedules (pools, bases, and calculated rates), the reconciliation of accounting records to claimed direct costs, and contract-level cost detail and over/underbilling schedules using the DCAA ICE model.
* Support DCAA and other audits of the incurred cost submission under the Accounting Team’s direction, including gathering data for auditor requests and preparing supporting schedules.

**Data Integrity & Compliance Analytics**

* Perform ongoing data integrity reviews of labor, cost, and organizational data flowing through Costpoint – checking completeness, accuracy, and consistent coding rather than financial performance or profitability.
* Design and run periodic data queries/checks to catch costs posted to the wrong organization, pool, or cost objective before they distort rate calculations or contract billings, and route findings to leadership for resolution.

**General Cost Accounting Support**

* Prepare journal entries related to indirect cost pools, cost allocations, and rate true-ups for review and posting approval.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities within the Accounting Team.
* Assist inter department personnel with rate proposals, budget rates, and ad hoc cost analysis in support of contract pricing and proposal efforts.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret Clearance if required.
* A minimum of five years of cost accounting experience in a government contracting environment.
* Hands-on experience with Deltek Costpoint, including indirect cost pool reconciliation and organization/department structure.
* Demonstrated experience supporting an Incurred Cost Submission (ICE model), such as building schedules or performing reconciliations.
* Working knowledge of FAR Part 31 cost principles and applicable Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), particularly as they apply to allowable/unallowable cost determination and consistent cost pool treatment.
* Experience calculating and reconciling indirect rates (fringe, overhead, G&A) against actual cost pools and provisional/billing rates.
* Strong analytical and data-validation skills, with the judgment to catch data integrity issues (miscoded, misallocated, or incomplete cost data) and escalate them before they affect rates or submissions.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; comfortable building and reviewing reconciliations and rate schedules from large data sets.
* High attention to detail, good judgment about what to escalate versus resolve independently, and comfort working directly with and reporting to the Controller.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a DCAA incurred cost audit or accounting system review.
* Exposure to CAS Disclosure Statement content or maintenance.
* Prior experience in the aerospace, defense, or broader federal government contracting industry.

* Company Paid Life and AD&D
* Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability

Remaining steadfast in our core values of *Trustworthy, Mission Driven, Creative, and Agile* we are a complex systems integrator for the U.S. Government, Detroit Defense provides solutions to meet the technical and programmatic challenges faced by our customers. From R&D to production, fielding, and sustainment, Detroit Defense provides services and solutions to Empower Those That protect Us.

title: Director of Procurement
description:
**About Us**

At Gifthealth, we’re revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We’re a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people’s lives.

**Position Summary**

We're looking for a Director of Pharmacy Procurement to lead how we source, contract, and manage the pharmaceutical supply that powers every patient's path from intake to delivery and adherence. Reporting to the Senior Director Pharmacy Supply Chain, you'll own the manufacturer and wholesaler relationships, pricing strategy, and supply chain resilience that keep our Digi+Hub running without gaps, lags, or friction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Procurement strategy:** Lead end-to-end sourcing for specialty and traditional medications, negotiating pricing, terms, and supply commitments with manufacturers, wholesalers, and group purchasing organizations.
* **Manufacturer and distributor relationships:** Build and manage partnerships with drug manufacturers and major distributors to secure priority allocation, favorable terms, and dependable supply, especially for high-demand specialty medications.
* **Contract lifecycle management:** Own the full RFP, negotiation, renewal, and vendor performance process, keeping every agreement aligned with cost, quality, and service goals.
* **Cross-functional demand planning:** Partner with clinical, pharmacy operations, and finance teams to forecast demand, manage inventory levels, and prevent stockouts across the prescription journey.
* **Compliance and risk management:** Ensure procurement practices meet DSCSA, state board of pharmacy, and payer requirements for drug-related spend, and extend that same rigor to data privacy, security, and insurance/indemnification standards across enterprise vendor contracts.
* **Market intelligence:** Track drug pricing trends, rebate opportunities, and supply constraints (including GLP-1 and other specialty categories) to proactively adjust sourcing strategy.
* **Team leadership:** Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing procurement team as Gifthealth scales.
* **Data analytics:** Design and build forecasting models for automation, and create dashboards to track supplier spend, inventory, and budgeting. Transform data and techniques into real-time predictive analytics that improve operational efficiency and drive supply chain optimization.
  + **Categories of spend managed:** Own procurement across categories beyond drug product, including:
  + **Corporate/technology procurement:** SaaS and software contracts (Five9, CallMiner, Forethought, etc.), IT hardware, and telephony.
  + **Facilities and capital equipment:** Buildout costs for potential new site locations, pharmacy automation capital purchases, and packaging/supplies beyond drug product.
  + **Professional services:** Consulting, staffing agencies, legal, and accreditation/compliance vendors.
  + **Non-pharma operational supplies:** Shipping and logistics contracts, and office and site supplies.
  + **Marketing/vendor spend:** Agency contracts and production vendors.
* **Governance and process ownership:** Set the enterprise-wide standards that keep procurement consistent and auditable, including:
  + **Procurement policy:** Own enterprise-wide procurement policy, approval thresholds, and PO/contract workflow.
  + **Vendor and contract records:** Maintain a centralized vendor master and contract repository across departments.
  + **Budget partnership:** Partner with Finance on budgeting across all cost centers.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 7+ years of experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare procurement and supply chain, including direct negotiation with drug manufacturers and wholesalers.
* Deep knowledge of pharmaceutical distribution channels, drug pricing structures, and regulatory requirements such as DSCSA and state pharmacy law.
* Proven track record managing complex vendor contracts and delivering measurable cost savings.
* Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, pharmacy, or a related field.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Interest in corporate procurement or strategic sourcing (SaaS/tech contracts, facilities, capital projects), not just drug supply chain.
* Contract and legal negotiation experience beyond manufacturer agreements, including MSAs, SOWs, and licensing terms.

**Preferred**

* Experience with specialty pharmacy or direct-to-patient (DTP) delivery models.
* Familiarity with GLP-1 and other high-demand specialty medication supply chains.
* PharmD or MBA.
* Experience building or scaling a procurement function at a high-growth health tech company.

* **Location:** Remote; some business travel may be required.
* **Schedule:** Full-time; reports to the Senior Director of Pharmacy Supply Chain

title: Director, Campaign Operations

At Cengage, our employees have a direct impact in helping learners around the world discover the power and joy of learning. We are bonded by our shared purpose – driving innovation that helps millions of learners improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

We are seeking a strategic and operationally minded **Director of Campaign Operations** to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of marketing programs, mature our campaign operations ecosystem, and drive growth.

This role will report to the Vice President, Marketing Operations within Cengage's marketing center-of-excellence and will lead a team responsible for enabling efficient, scalable, and high-quality campaign execution and evolution for Marketing.

The Director, Campaign Operations will define how campaigns move from strategy to execution—bringing together people, process, technology, workflow, and data to help marketers execute more effectively. This leader will build a modern campaign production model that balances operational rigor with flexibility and innovation while enabling increasingly personalized customer experiences at scale.

The role requires a blend of strategic leadership, operational excellence, and technical depth. The ideal candidate is a player-coach: equally comfortable defining a long-term capability roadmap and rolling up their sleeves to solve complex execution challenges alongside their team.

This is a leadership role for someone with a proven track record of building efficient campaign operations in complex enterprise environments, translating marketer needs into scalable capabilities and services, and leading high-performing teams.

This is a remote role with occasional travel required.

**What you'll do here:**
------------------------

**Own Campaign Operations Excellence**

  

* Define and evolve the enterprise campaign operations strategy, operating model, production processes, governance, and service model to enable scalable campaign execution.
* Build and optimize an efficient production model using a combination of internal teams, marketer self-service, and external agency or managed-service resources.
* Establish planning standards, templates, workflows, intake processes, and reusable campaign components that help marketers work faster while maintaining quality and consistency.
* Drive operational excellence by measuring and improving campaign production timelines, velocity, throughput, quality, and predictability.
* Identify bottlenecks and opportunities across the campaign lifecycle and implement improvements that accelerate time-to-market, increase quality, and drive outcomes.
* Establish clear expectations, operational metrics, and continuous improvement practices across campaign operations.

**Unlock Marketing Capabilities to Drive Growth**
-------------------------------------------------

  

* Own the campaign operations capability roadmap, translating business priorities and marketer needs into scalable campaign execution, personalization, and automation capabilities.
* Partner with Marketing, Revenue, Digital, and Product leaders to align campaign investments and operational priorities with growth objectives.
* Define and evolve capabilities that improve customer engagement, including audience targeting, journey orchestration, personalization, and lifecycle marketing.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve marketer productivity and campaign effectiveness through automation, AI, reusable content, self-service, and workflow innovation.
* Translate operational insights and marketer feedback into new services, capabilities, and ways of working that accelerate growth.
* Balance capability expansion with operational efficiency, scalability, and long-term sustainability.

**Provide Marketing Automation Leadership and Governance**
----------------------------------------------------------

  

* Provide leadership and governance for campaign operations platforms and integrated systems, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Workfront, Data 360, and related technologies.
* Serve as the campaign operations subject matter expert, representing campaign execution requirements in MarTech, data, workflow, and architecture discussions.
* Partner with Marketing Technology, Data, Digital, Analytics, and IT teams to ensure campaign capabilities are scalable, integrated, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Guide the design and implementation of automated customer journeys, triggered communications, and campaign execution frameworks.
* Establish governance for campaign configuration, audience management, workflow, templates, data usage, and operational standards.
* Monitor platform performance, campaign health, deliverability, data quality, and operational reliability.
* Ensure campaign operations capabilities align with enterprise data models, privacy requirements, compliance standards, and technology roadmaps.

**Drive Campaign Performance and Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------------------

  

* Partner with marketers, audience owners, and campaign managers to translate business objectives into efficient and scalable campaign execution plans.
* Implement testing, measurement, and optimization practices that improve campaign effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* Build dashboards and reporting that provide insight into production workflow, campaign velocity, quality, service levels, and execution outcomes.
* Own campaign operations prioritization and capacity planning frameworks.
* Use operational and campaign performance data to find opportunities for improvement and prioritize investments.
* Establish mechanisms to capture feedback from marketers and continuously improve the campaign experience and operating model.

**Collaboration and Enablement**
--------------------------------

  

* Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Digital, IT, Analytics, Legal, Marketing Technology, and Marketing Operations.
* Be an advisor to help Marketing improve results across automation, email, and owned channels while staying within governance and compliance.
* Serve as a strategic partner to marketers by understanding their needs and helping translate those needs into scalable capabilities and operational solutions.
* Develop documentation, training programs, playbooks, and onboarding materials that enable marketers and campaign teams to work effectively within the campaign operating model.
* Help establish clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes across teams involved in campaign planning, production, activation, and measurement.
* Resolve complex campaign operations and platform-related challenges while identifying themes for foundational solutions.

**Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team**
-------------------------------------------

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of automation strategists and campaign producers.
* Balance efficient execution within campaign squads, with a broader center-of-excellence approach that elevates marketing operations across the entire global organization.
* Build a strong player-coach culture where leaders and team members combine operational rigor with hands-on problem solving.
* Establish clear goals, development plans, performance expectations, and success metrics for team members.
* Manage external agency and managed-service resources to ensure clear accountability, efficient use of capacity, and high-quality delivery.
* Build organizational resilience through documentation, cross-training, standardized processes, and scalable ways of working.

**Skills you will need here:**
------------------------------

  

* 10+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign operations, marketing automation, or related marketing technology and production functions, including experience leading teams in complex enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated experience building and operating efficient, scalable campaign production or marketing automation models.
* Strong understanding of marketing strategies, campaign operations, marketing automation, workflow management, and production processes.
* Experience translating business and marketer requirements into technology, process, workflow, or automation solutions.
* Demonstrated experience improving operational efficiency, campaign velocity, quality, and time-to-market.
* Strong understanding of personalization, segmentation, customer journeys, testing, and campaign optimization.
* Experience managing internal production teams alongside external agencies, managed services, or other flexible resource models.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using operational and performance data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Ability to balance strategy with operational execution and technical problem solving.
* Strong executive communication, marketing partner management, and cross-functional leadership skills.

**Preferred Experience:**
-------------------------

  

* Hands-on expertise with marketing automation platforms, with Salesforce Marketing Cloud strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with Workfront or other enterprise workflow and work management platforms.
* Success operating within centralized marketing operations organizations or center-of-excellence models.
* Success supporting large-scale B2B, B2C, and/or B2B2C campaign operations.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design
  
  
**Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.**

We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
